ACTIVATION:a runtime module is active only after identity,permission,interface,dependency,lifecycle,test,resource,observability and failure-injection evidence pass;missing identity-group registration remains mandated-pending-registration and cannot be inferred. SEARCH:module_code is indexed for direct architecture and Codex lookup. HISTORY:revision_history remains user-deleted.
articles.prohibition: FORBID:monolithic whole-system executor+structural node executing+module without unique code or failure domain+shared mutable cross-module state+implicit dependency+direct cross-module call+more than three unregistered capabilities+one module failure stopping system+whole-UI refresh+global automation lock+identity group inferred without directory proof+architecture profile duplicating path authority+history reconstruction.
articles.exception: A shared service is its own runtime module with independent identity,lifecycle,contract and failure boundary;being shared never permits callers to own or bypass it.

articles.subject: universal-module-source-line-limit
articles.rule: SCOPE:every GPTBridge-authored module without exception,including platform-core+independent-tools+information/shared-layer+Xingcheng auxiliary+UI+backend+sovereign-support+sub-sovereign-support+executors+adapters+services+workers+launchers+scripts+migrations+tests+checkers+build/package+governance-support; LIMITS:each authored source module/file<=500 effective-lines+each class/type<=300 effective-lines+each function/method/procedure/query-unit<=50 effective-lines; INHERITANCE:every top-level+runtime+structural+internal+recursive module inherits these limits and no module kind/title/criticality grants exemption; COUNTING:nonblank+noncomment physical-lines including decorators+signatures+control-flow+embedded templates/JSX/SQL+macros+declarations; language parser emits deterministic file/symbol/count/limit/content-hash evidence; ambiguous or unavailable count=INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE and never PASS; ENFORCEMENT:file-save+pre-commit+integration+release and changed-startup activation; RESULT:over-limit=FAIL+block changed module activation/merge/release until cohesive decomposition preserves owner+public contract+API/ABI+state+tests+fault boundary; GENERATED/THIRD-PARTY:only registered externally authored immutable artifacts are classified outside authored-source counting while every GPTBridge-authored generator+wrapper+adapter remains bounded; HISTORY:revision_history remains user-deleted.
articles.prohibition: FORBID:any authored-module exception+folder-wide/path-glob waiver+critical/startup/security/test/governance exemption+minification+statement-joining+comment/blank padding+partial-class splitting+macro/include-chain hiding+embedded-code hiding+generated relabeling+duplicate thin modules that preserve one monolithic responsibility+checker self-waiver+missing evidence treated as pass.
articles.exception: No GPTBridge-authored module is exempt. Registered immutable third-party or generated artifacts are evidence classes, not authored modules; their authored generator and boundary adapters remain fully subject to the limits.

articles.subject: mandatory-module-self-decomposition
articles.rule: SCOPE:every GPTBridge-authored module governed by A426; TRIGGER:any module/file>500 effective-lines+class/type>300+function/method/procedure/query-unit>50 or projected change would exceed-limit; RESPONSE:module must enter SELF_DECOMPOSITION_REQUIRED and cannot receive further feature growth until split completes; RESPONSIBILITY:the owning module produces a deterministic decomposition plan and the governed module-execution layer performs the split within that module boundary; CHECKER-BOUNDARY:Language Boundary Gate remains read-only and only emits exact path+symbol+measured-lines+limit+content-hash+dependency evidence;it never edits,moves,renames or creates exceptions; PLAN:identify cohesive responsibilities+public entrypoints+state owner+dependency edges+contract/API/ABI+tests+rollback point,then assign stable child module codes with one responsibility and at-most-three registered capabilities each; EXECUTION:create child modules>move behavior without duplication>rewrite internal references>preserve external contract>run original-language unit tests+pytest integration when cross-language>run dependency-cycle+ownership+contract+line-limit gates>atomic promote; SAFETY:work occurs on an isolated snapshot with source revision and content hashes;failure rolls back only the decomposition candidate and leaves active runtime unchanged;no reset/overwrite of unrelated code;channels and unaffected modules continue; COMPLETION:all resulting authored modules/classes/callables pass A426+behavior parity+dependency DAG+ownership uniqueness+test and release evidence;old root implementation is removed after verified promotion so no legacy duplicate remains; AUTOMATION:self-decomposition may be scheduled automatically but source mutation requires the registered governed execution command and applicable user confirmation policy; HISTORY:revision_history remains user-deleted.
articles.prohibition: FORBID:checker auto-fix+self-split without evidence or governed executor+splitting only by line count while retaining mixed responsibility+facade containing old implementation+duplicate old/new behavior+public contract drift+state ownership duplication+dependency cycle+cross-module private import+generated relabeling+limit waiver+feature growth while SELF_DECOMPOSITION_REQUIRED+whole-system stop+unrelated-file rewrite+reset/overwrite rollback+declaring completion before all resulting units pass.
articles.exception: No authored module may opt out; an active emergency path may remain running unchanged while its isolated decomposition candidate is prepared and verified, but it may not receive unrelated feature growth.

articles.subject: bounded-self-decomposition-orchestration-and-evidence-closure
articles.rule: SCOPE:A427 self-decomposition for every over-limit authored module; SEMANTICS:self means the affected module owns its decomposition requirement and evidence,not autonomous self-modifying code; INVENTORY:Language Boundary Gate creates one immutable violation record per exact file+symbol+limit with source revision,content hash,owner,module code,dependency impact,severity and detection time; QUEUE:星澄 auxiliary automation coordinator groups records by module and dispatches registered SELF_DECOMPOSE_MODULE commands;permission-sovereign validates only identity+scope+path+command authority;module-execution components alone mutate source; ORDER:build affected dependency graph,collapse existing cycles as blocked remediation units,then process acyclic leaf modules before dependents;one module has at most one active decomposition generation;overlapping paths,state owners,contracts or artifacts are mutually exclusive;disjoint modules may run bounded parallel on multiple cores; BUDGET:each job declares CPU+memory+I/O+deadline+maximum files+maximum retry and yields to runtime health;queue pressure applies backpressure and never starves fault/security repair; CHANGE-POLICY:while SELF_DECOMPOSITION_REQUIRED,only decomposition plus narrowly scoped defect/security/stability repair may change the module;such repair cannot increase measured debt and must carry separate evidence; ATOMICITY:stage complete candidate generation,verify every resulting child and all affected consumers,then atomically publish exact revision;partial success is never promoted;old root removal and reference/build-manifest updates occur in the same certified change; RECOVERY:on timeout,crash,conflict,test failure,contract drift or resource breach isolate candidate>retain active generation>emit exact fault code and files>retry only when evidence permits>otherwise await decision;no retry storm; EVIDENCE:before/after line counts+module map+dependency DAG+cycle result+owner/capability registry+API/ABI/contract hashes+tests+resource result+removed-old-root proof+final revision; CODEX-INTEGRITY:every amendment atomically rebuilds current module manifests,search documents,physical FTS hash,query-plan benchmarks and search manifest before sealing;stale derived evidence is INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE; HISTORY:revision_history remains user-deleted.
articles.prohibition: FORBID:self-modifying runtime+checker mutation+unregistered command+module owner self-approval+parallel overlapping splits+branch-name-only candidate identity+partial promotion+cycle ignored+unbounded retry/resource use+feature growth disguised as repair+debt increase+consumer verification omission+old-root duplicate+stale manifest/search/benchmark evidence+missing evidence treated as pass+system-wide stop or rollback.
articles.exception: A currently active over-limit module may continue unchanged to preserve service; only isolated verified candidates may replace it, and no exception permits new line-limit debt.

articles.subject: module-self-decomposition-command-state-and-exception-closure
articles.rule: SCOPE:all A428 decomposition work; COMMAND:MODULE_SELF_DECOMPOSE with canonical id module-self-decompose is the sole mutation entry and is dispatched by 星澄 auxiliary automation coordinator through the information layer after permission scope validation; STATE-MACHINE:DETECTED>PLANNED>AUTHORIZED>STAGING>VERIFYING>PROMOTED,with BLOCKED|FAILED>ROLLED_BACK and exact transition evidence;no state may be inferred from elapsed time,file presence or process exit alone; IDENTITY:each job binds decomposition_id+module_code+owner+task_id+source_revision+base_content_root+target_paths+contract_hash+dependency_graph_hash+generation+correlation_id+requested_at_utc+authorization proof;queue entry is immutable and execution targets the bound revision,never a moving branch; AUTHORIZATION:an explicit current user one-time command is legal authorization for its exact scope;automatic recurring execution requires a separate registered user-controlled switch and cannot be inferred from this one-time request; EXCEPTION-CLOSURE:source_exceptions grants no line-limit waiver after A426;all authored registry,policy,governance,test,migration,launcher and generator sources obey the same limits;legacy exception rows are retired from effective authority; VERIFICATION:result binds child module identities+before/after hashes+line-count evidence+API/ABI/contract parity+dependency acyclicity+tests+resource budget+old-root removal+audit validation;only complete evidence permits PROMOTED; REPORT:each failure names exact file+symbol+rule+fault code+state+expected+observed+owner+next action and never reports a generic decomposition failure; CODEX-DERIVED-EVIDENCE:every amendment refreshes manifests+FTS+benchmarks+search seal atomically; HISTORY:revision_history remains user-deleted.
articles.prohibition: FORBID:alternate decomposition command+direct subprocess/editor mutation+moving branch target+implicit or expired authorization+recurring automation from one-time command+line-limit exception registry+generic failure+state skipping+promotion with stale/missing evidence+old-root retention+checker repair+permission-sovereign execution+星澄 direct source execution+history reconstruction.
articles.exception: No authored-source exception exists. An immutable third-party or generated artifact classification does not exempt its GPTBridge-authored generator, wrapper or adapter.

articles.subject: source-line-evidence-and-self-decomposition-directory-special-law
articles.rule: DIRECTORIES:DIR_SOURCE_LINE_LIMIT_EVIDENCE and DIR_MODULE_SELF_DECOMPOSITION are the sole normalized directories for A426-A429 measurements and jobs; OWNER:permission-sovereign owns identity,format,registration,lifecycle and validation only; PRODUCERS:read-only language checkers submit measured evidence and 星澄 submits classification+plan+dispatch evidence through the information layer;module executors submit execution results;none may register,validate or rewrite its own record; LINE-EVIDENCE:one record binds evidence_id+module_code+canonical source code/path reference+language+source_class+symbol_kind+symbol_identity+effective_lines+limit+content_hash+source_revision+parser/checker/policy versions+result+timestamp+lineage; DECOMPOSITION-JOB:one record binds decomposition_id+module_code+violation evidence ids+state+owner+task+source revision+candidate revision+target codes+locked paths/contracts/state owners/artifacts+authorization+resource budget+attempt+fault codes+verification hashes+audit+timestamps+lineage; CARDINALITY:each active over-limit evidence belongs to exactly one current module and zero-or-one open decomposition job;one job may resolve many violations in that same module;cross-module work uses separately linked jobs; LIFECYCLE:evidence is append-only and becomes resolved|superseded|stale without overwrite;job transitions follow A429 and every transition is a new event;PROMOTED requires all bound violations resolved by current after-evidence; FRESHNESS:source,parser,checker,policy,contract,dependency graph or module generation hash change marks affected evidence stale and blocks reuse;unknown or missing registry state is INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE; SEARCH:exact evidence/job/module/state/fault/revision lookup uses indexed coded fields;free text is never identity; RETENTION:records remain through release and audit retention then archive with hash-chain continuity; HISTORY:revision_history remains user-deleted.
articles.prohibition: FORBID:local/private exception list+free-text-only identity+path literal as authority+self-registration+self-validation+mutable evidence overwrite+one job silently spanning unrelated modules+multiple open jobs for same module generation+stale evidence reuse+state inferred from process/file presence+PROMOTED with unresolved violation+deleting failure evidence+directory content creating or relaxing Codex law.
articles.exception: Read-only historical records may be archived after governed retention; archival never reactivates evidence, authorizes execution or removes the current compliance requirement.

articles.subject: module-line-count-registry-special-law
articles.rule: DIRECTORY:DIR_MODULE_LINE_COUNT_REGISTRY canonical-name module-line-count-registry is the sole current module line-count roster; OWNER:permission-sovereign owns registration,format,lifecycle and validation; SCOPE:every GPTBridge-authored source module in Python+TypeScript+C+C+++CSharp+SQL,including tests+scripts+launchers+checkers+build helpers+governance support+generators+wrappers+adapters; ROW:one current row per canonical module_code+source_unit_code and exact source revision,containing language+source_class+effective_lines+module_limit=500+largest_class_lines+class_limit=300+largest_callable_lines+callable_limit=50+class_violation_count+callable_violation_count+overall_result+content_hash+measurement_evidence_ids+decomposition_id+measured_at_utc+lineage; SOURCE:values are a validated projection of DIR_SOURCE_LINE_LIMIT_EVIDENCE and never self-reported by the module;the roster cannot create law,change a limit,grant an exception or replace evidence; STATUS:PASS|SELF_DECOMPOSITION_REQUIRED|INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE|STALE,with FAIL evidence projected as SELF_DECOMPOSITION_REQUIRED;missing current source/parser/checker/policy/revision hash is INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE;changed input is STALE until remeasured; RELATION:each roster row resolves exactly one project architecture module and one-or-more current measurement evidence records;an over-limit row resolves zero-or-one open DIR_MODULE_SELF_DECOMPOSITION job; UPDATE:source change creates a successor roster revision after deterministic recount;prior row becomes historical and remains audit-linked;no in-place evidence rewrite; QUERY:index module_code+overall_result,module_code+language,source_revision and decomposition_id;reports name exact source unit+measured values+limits+largest symbols+evidence and required action; GATES:save updates affected roster candidates;precommit validates changed and transitive scope;integration and release require complete current roster coverage and zero unresolved over-limit changed module; HISTORY:revision_history remains user-deleted.
articles.prohibition: FORBID:unregistered authored module+folder aggregate hiding an oversized file+average-line count+module self-report as authority+free-text identity+hardcoded alternate limit+exception/waiver field+PASS with missing/stale evidence+overwriting history+multiple current rows for same module/source/revision+decomposition completion without compliant successor row+roster used to mutate code or decide its own validation.
articles.exception: Immutable third-party and generated artifacts remain separately classified; every GPTBridge-authored generator, wrapper and adapter has its own mandatory roster row.

articles.subject: module-line-count-roster-normalized-counting-and-aggregation
articles.rule: DIRECTORY:DIR_MODULE_LINE_COUNT_REGISTRY remains the sole roster; LANGUAGE-CODES:PYTHON|TYPESCRIPT|C|CPP|CSHARP|SQL exactly,never concatenated display text or inferred aliases; RECORD-KINDS:SOURCE_UNIT and ARCHITECTURE_MODULE_SUMMARY; SOURCE_UNIT means one canonical GPTBridge-authored physical source file after path-code resolution;ARCHITECTURE_MODULE_SUMMARY is a derived aggregate over all current source units assigned to one module_code; LIMIT-APPLICATION:500 applies independently to every SOURCE_UNIT,300 to each class/type declaration and 50 to each callable/query unit;architecture-module aggregate lines are observability only and never cause failure merely because the sum exceeds 500;one violating source unit or symbol makes its module summary SELF_DECOMPOSITION_REQUIRED; BOUNDARY:effective_lines>limit is violation and effective_lines<=limit passes when all other evidence is complete;warning begins at the registered 80-percent threshold but never changes PASS/FAIL; NORMALIZATION:decode by registered source encoding,reject undecodable or mixed-identity content,normalize CRLF/CR to LF,remove only blank-only and language-parser-proven comment-only physical lines,and count every remaining physical line once;multiline declarations/strings/templates/JSX/preprocessor/macros/embedded SQL and generated host-language fragments count by occupied physical lines; LANGUAGE:PYTHON counts decorators+signatures+suites;TYPESCRIPT counts declarations+types+JSX;C and CPP count directives+declarations+definitions while canonical header ownership remains A215;CSHARP counts attributes+declarations+members;SQL counts DDL+DML+procedural blocks+comments only when not comment-only; PATH-IDENTITY:resolve directory code to one canonical path,case-normalize under Windows policy and reject alternate data streams+trailing-dot/space+symlink/junction/hardlink alias duplication;the same content at distinct authored source identities is counted separately and duplicate implementation is independently reviewed; SUMMARY-FIELDS:module_code+source_unit_count+aggregate_effective_lines+largest_source_unit+largest_source_unit_lines+largest_class+largest_class_lines+largest_callable+largest_callable_lines+violating_source_unit_count+current_revision+evidence_root+overall_result; FRESHNESS:inventory addition,removal,rename,language/source-class change or ownership reassignment invalidates both source-unit and module-summary rows;release full scan proves roster source-unit identities equal authored source inventory exactly; HISTORY:revision_history remains user-deleted.
articles.prohibition: FORBID:500-line limit applied to architecture aggregate+folder/package treated as one source unit+multiple files combined to hide an individual violation+one file split by parser regions to evade 500+language alias ambiguity+C+++ token ambiguity+byte count+statement count+formatted/minified logical-line substitution+comment parser guessing+path-alias duplicate row+missing summary+summary PASS while any child is fail/stale/incomplete+inventory mismatch accepted.
articles.exception: No authored source unit is exempt. Module aggregates may exceed 500 because their limit is structural decomposition and single-responsibility evidence,not the per-file threshold.

articles.subject: authored-source-inventory-and-line-roster-completeness
articles.rule: DIRECTORY:DIR_AUTHORED_SOURCE_INVENTORY is the sole normalized discovery inventory feeding A432; OWNER:permission-sovereign owns identity,root scope,classification lifecycle and validation; DISCOVERY:scan every registered project/root code recursively without crossing its top-level boundary and emit one canonical identity per filesystem entry before language filtering;apply registered ignore rules only by exact code+owner+reason+scope+expiry/hash,never by checker-local glob; CLASSIFICATION:AUTHORED_ALLOWED|AUTHORED_FORBIDDEN|GENERATED|THIRD_PARTY|BUILD_METADATA|NON_SOURCE;AUTHORED_ALLOWED requires one A215 language code and enters DIR_MODULE_LINE_COUNT_REGISTRY;AUTHORED_FORBIDDEN retains exact path code,extension,hash,owner and line measurement evidence but causes Language Boundary FAIL and can never disappear from roster completeness by lacking an allowed language; PROVENANCE:GENERATED requires generator identity+generator revision+artifact hash+target language+reproducibility;THIRD_PARTY requires immutable package/vendor/source/license/hash and bounded adapter;unknown provenance is AUTHORED_FORBIDDEN or INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE,never generated/third-party by location alone; BUILD-METADATA:project/package/CMake/tsconfig/csproj/migration manifests are non-source only while declarative;embedded executable application/domain code is extracted as AUTHORED_FORBIDDEN evidence and cannot evade language or line limits; IDENTITY:inventory_id+root_code+module_code+source_unit_code+path_code+entry_kind+extension+source_class+language_code-or-null+owner+size_bytes+content_hash+provenance_hash+discovered_at_utc+revision+status+lineage; PARITY:full integration/release proves discovered current authored entries=allowed roster source units union forbidden authored findings exactly;no orphan roster row,no unclassified authored candidate and no missing file;save/precommit use affected scope but cannot certify full completeness; CHANGE:create/delete/rename/move/hardlink/junction/symlink/extension/owner/root/ignore/provenance change invalidates affected inventory,roster,dependency,ownership and contract evidence;deleted entries become tombstoned then purged only after audit and consumer verification; POWERSHELL:existing ps1 is AUTHORED_FORBIDDEN governance-conflict/legacy-infrastructure evidence unless a successor law migrates it or explicitly changes the six-language policy;checker cannot invent an exception or seventh language; HISTORY:revision_history remains user-deleted.
articles.prohibition: FORBID:language-filter-before-inventory+unregistered ignore glob+ignored root hiding source+generated/third-party inferred from folder+forbidden authored file omitted from completeness+PowerShell silently allowed+build metadata carrying hidden executable logic+path alias double identity+cross-top-level scan+missing file treated as clean+incremental scan claiming full parity+checker creating classification exception+hard delete without tombstone/audit.
articles.exception: Externally created immutable third-party and reproducible generated artifacts are classified,not exempted;their GPTBridge-authored generators and adapters remain AUTHORED_ALLOWED roster members.

articles.subject: module-line-roster-ownership-cohesion-and-fragmentation-gate
articles.rule: SCOPE:DIR_AUTHORED_SOURCE_INVENTORY+DIR_MODULE_LINE_COUNT_REGISTRY+DIR_SOURCE_LINE_LIMIT_EVIDENCE+DIR_MODULE_SELF_DECOMPOSITION; OWNERSHIP:every AUTHORED_ALLOWED or AUTHORED_FORBIDDEN source candidate resolves exactly one active project architecture module_code and one accountable source owner;zero owners,multiple owners,retired owner or structural container claimed as executable owner is FAIL; LOCATION:canonical path must lie inside its registered module root;shared neutral contract source is a separately registered shared module and cannot be multiply owned by callers;moving a source unit changes ownership only through one atomic directory successor with dependency and contract review; ORPHANS:a discovered source with no module,an inventory row with missing physical entry,or a roster row absent from inventory is ORPHANED and blocks affected integration/release;locator failure never silently drops the row; COHESION:self-decomposition splits by cohesive responsibility and registered capability,not arbitrary line ranges;each child has one primary responsibility,one owner,explicit interface,state boundary and declared dependencies;facades contain routing/compatibility only and cannot retain displaced business/algorithmic behavior; ANTI-FRAGMENTATION:no fixed minimum file size is legal authority,but the Gate emits WARN with evidence for suspicious fragmentation such as many near-empty siblings,one former callable mechanically spread across files,cyclic include/import fanout,pass-through chains,duplicate symbols or shared mutable state;confirmed evasion is FAIL under A426; DEPENDENCY:every added child edge enters the unified language graph;cycles,private cross-module imports,forbidden language edges and undeclared build references fail before promotion;module summary records source_unit_count+dependency fan-in/fan-out+cycle result+cohesion evidence root; RENAME/DELETE:old source identity becomes superseded or tombstoned,all imports/includes/build/test/contract references are verified and the old physical root is removed only after promotion;reappearance of a tombstoned identity is a new conflict,not automatic restoration; RESULT:PASS requires inventory parity+unique ownership+line compliance+cohesion+dependency validity+current evidence;WARN never hides line or ownership failure;FAIL and INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE name exact file,module,owner,edge,symbol,rule and required action; HISTORY:revision_history remains user-deleted.
articles.prohibition: FORBID:unowned or multiply owned source+structural node execution ownership+source outside module root+shared file owned by every caller+arbitrary line-range split+empty-file padding+pass-through file chain+facade retaining implementation+duplicate symbols/shared mutable state+cycle or undeclared edge+orphan silently removed+rename without successor+old root re-created by repair+warning used to downgrade FAIL.
articles.exception: Small cohesive source units are legal; size alone never proves fragmentation. Fragmentation becomes FAIL only with deterministic responsibility,dependency,duplication or evasion evidence.

articles.subject: codex-read-access-tier-and-import-time-self-declaration-convergence
articles.rule: CONTROLLING-RULE:this article consolidates operational read controls formerly spread across A74+A107+A173+A174;A74 remains citation syntax,A107 remains official storage,A173 remains Chinese confidentiality,and this article solely controls runtime access cost and session policy; ACCESS-CLASSES:SELF_DECLARATION_LOCAL|BOUNDED_MACHINE_LOOKUP|REVIEW_SESSION|XINGCHENG_CHINESE_REVIEW; SELF_DECLARATION_LOCAL:import-time module self-declaration may load only module-authored static typed identifiers already belonging to itself,including module_code+identity_group_code+capability codes+contract ids+command codes+interface version+owner code;this performs no Codex read,no SQLite/file/network access,no rule-text lookup,no authority decision and therefore requires no Codex session,per-import permission review or read audit; DECLARATION-CONSTRAINT:declaration is inert data only,deterministic,side-effect-free,non-secret and bounded;it cannot grant permission,activate execution,change status,infer law or claim conformance;after imports settle,the process submits one declaration set hash for once-per-process-generation reconciliation against the official entry before affected capability activation; BOUNDED_MACHINE_LOOKUP:exact machine lookup of registered non-content identity/status/binding may reuse one authenticated process-generation read context and one permission decision keyed by actor+purpose+scope+Codex version+policy hash until expiry/revocation/version change;reads are accumulated into a bounded append-only batch digest with per-request correlation references rather than requiring a new session and full audit row for each lookup; REVIEW_SESSION:rule text,reasoning-sensitive metadata,broad search,cross-module inspection,adjudication evidence,export or human-facing citation requires official entry+identity+purpose+least scope+nonce+expiry+read-only session+permission review+content-free audit;A74 explicit provision id applies to citation; XINGCHENG_CHINESE_REVIEW:A173 confidentiality remains unchanged:星澄 only,official entry,identity,purpose,scope,single-use read-only session and metadata-only audit,permission-review exempt;no cache,batch shortcut,import-time declaration or process context may contain Chinese Codex content; CACHE:bounded lookup cache stores only typed result+Codex version+policy hash+scope hash+expiry+revocation generation;any mismatch discards it and revalidates;cache is derived,non-authoritative,non-RAG and cannot outlive process generation; FAILURE:self declaration mismatch blocks only affected capability activation and reports exact module/field/expected/observed/rule;official Codex unavailability leaves already certified active generation running but denies new activation or authority expansion;unaffected imports continue; AUDIT:one process reconciliation event plus bounded lookup batch digests preserves actor,purpose,scope,version,request count,correlation root,result and timestamps without Codex content;security denial,scope expansion and review session remain individually audited; HISTORY:revision_history remains user-deleted.
articles.prohibition: FORBID:Codex read disguised as self declaration+import-time SQLite/file/network access+rule text or Chinese content in declaration/cache+declaration granting authority+activation before reconciliation+process context reused across actor,purpose,scope,version,expiry or revocation+audit batching that loses request correlation+full review through bounded lookup+permission cache self-issued by caller+alternate entry+direct database read+Chinese shortcut+Codex/RAG mirror.
articles.exception: Import-time self-declaration is a formal no-read path,not an access bypass. Test discovery and static tooling may load the same inert declaration data; any conformance or activation claim still requires official reconciliation.

articles.subject: permission-decision-and-directory-authority-execution-boundary
articles.rule: SIMPLE-BOUNDARY:permission-sovereign decides;DirectoryAuthority executes exact directory transactions;permission-sovereign never writes and DirectoryAuthority never decides. TERMS:MANAGE is a non-executable umbrella for policy ownership and lifecycle accountability and must not appear as a mutation operation;ISSUE means decide creation of one permission identity/revision;TERMINATE means decide final closure with successor-or-none and no implicit deletion;SUPERVISE means read-only observe+compare+report+request-review and grants no mutation or decision; DECISION-ACTIONS:ISSUE|DENY|RENEW|RESTRICT|SUSPEND|REVOKE|TERMINATE only;permission-sovereign selects exactly one action after required 星澄 review evidence,scope validation and Codex basis;decision output is immutable and cannot execute itself. DIRECTORY-OPERATIONS:CREATE_REVISION|ACTIVATE_REVISION|MARK_RESTRICTED|MARK_SUSPENDED|MARK_REVOKED|MARK_TERMINATED|NO_OP only;DirectoryAuthority accepts a current valid decision proof,maps its action through the registered deterministic action-operation table,locks the exact directory identity,performs one transaction,returns receipt and has no fallback operation. DECISION-RECORD:decision_id+decision_revision+action_code+subject_identity+permission_identity+resource_code+scope_codes+constraint_codes+basis_provision_ids+review_evidence_ids+issuer_identity+issued_at_utc+effective_at_utc+expires_at_utc-or-null+predecessor_decision_id-or-null+correlation_id+content_hash+signature_status+lifecycle_state; EXECUTION-RECEIPT:execution_id+decision_id+decision_revision+directory_code+entry_identity+operation_code+executor_identity+transaction_id+idempotency_key+before_revision/hash-or-null+after_revision/hash-or-null+started_at_utc+completed_at_utc+result_code+fault_codes+verification_evidence_id+correlation_id+receipt_hash; SUPERVISION-OBSERVATION:observation_id+observer_identity+directory_code+entry_identity+expected_decision_revision+observed_revision/hash/status+comparison_result+fault_codes+recorded_at_utc+correlation_id+evidence_hash;it may open review/repair requests but cannot alter entries. PERSISTENCE:decision records reside in the permission decision ledger;directory state resides only in permission-owned canonical directories;execution receipts and supervision observations are append-only linked records;Audit stores correlated immutable events;all use directory/environment codes rather than physical database/path literals. STATE:PROPOSED>REVIEWED>DECIDED>EXECUTING>APPLIED>VERIFIED,with DENIED|EXPIRED before execution and FAILED>ROLLED_BACK after execution failure;SUSPENDED|REVOKED|TERMINATED are explicit directory lifecycle results,not generic process states. IDEMPOTENCY:same decision_id+revision+entry+operation returns the prior verified receipt;different payload under same key is conflict;stale,expired,revoked,wrong-scope or already-consumed proof is NO_OP or deny according to registered mapping and never guessed. FAILURE:invalid proof or mapping denies before write;transaction failure rolls back only exact target;verification mismatch isolates entry and emits exact code;unaffected permissions and directories continue. HISTORY:revision_history remains user-deleted.
articles.prohibition: FORBID:permission-sovereign direct persistence+DirectoryAuthority policy choice+MANAGE as executable verb+SUPERVISE mutation+ISSUE without immutable decision+TERMINATE as hard delete+action inferred from method name+unregistered action-operation mapping+decision and receipt merged into one mutable row+self-issued review/permission+in-place history rewrite+physical path/database hardcode+retry with changed payload+generic success without after-hash verification.
articles.exception: A governed executor may retry the same immutable idempotent directory operation after a transient failure; retry never changes the decision,scope,target,operation or payload.

articles.subject: internal-call-and-governed-boundary-classification
articles.rule: CLASSES:PURE_INTERNAL_CALL|INTRA_MODULE_COMPONENT_CALL|GOVERNED_BOUNDARY_CALL. PURE_INTERNAL_CALL:same process+module_code+owner+trust domain+permission context+runtime generation+state owner,ordinary deterministic method/function call,no serialization/IPC/network/database/queue/event/privilege/state-owner transition;it needs no information-layer session,transport envelope or per-call audit. INTRA_MODULE_COMPONENT_CALL:same module and authority but different internal component;direct typed call/import is allowed only along declared dependency DAG and stable internal interface;no transport required solely because labels such as application/service/repository/worker differ. GOVERNED_BOUNDARY_CALL:any change of module owner,sovereign authority,permission principal,process/runtime identity,trust zone,state/data owner,external side effect or independently versioned contract;it requires a typed governed contract,scope validation,correlation and evidence,but may use an in-process dispatcher when co-located and need not pretend to be network IPC. DECISION:classify by runtime facts,not directory/layer names. SUPPORT:tests,diagnostics,startup and one-time scripts remain governed source but ordinary internal helper calls do not become cross-layer communication.
articles.prohibition: FORBID:layer-name-alone forcing IPC+internal call bypassing a real owner/authority/permission/data boundary+network/queue/database call labeled pure+same process used to hide cross-principal call+per-method session/audit inflation+direct private cross-module import.
articles.exception: A pure call may emit optional performance tracing;tracing does not change its boundary class or create governance authority.

articles.subject: canonical-sovereign-sub-sovereign-executor-responsibility-model
articles.rule: CANONICAL-ROLES:SOVEREIGN=DECIDE,SUB_SOVEREIGN=MANAGE_AND_DISPATCH,EXECUTOR=EXECUTE,INFORMATION_LAYER=CONTRACT_AND_STATUS,PERMISSION_SOVEREIGN=VALIDATE_PERMISSION_SCOPE,XINGCHENG=REVIEW_AND_COORDINATE_WITHIN_PRIVILEGE. INHERITANCE:all domain-specific provisions reference these role codes and state only domain additions;they must not restate the common pipeline. SOVEREIGN outputs immutable decision intent and never performs work. SUB_SOVEREIGN validates domain preconditions,selects registered module executor,schedules/bounds work and never performs domain execution. EXECUTOR accepts exact decision+scope+generation,mutates only assigned target and returns receipt. STATUS reporters observe and never decide or execute. TRANSPORT:role transition requires typed evidence but co-located transitions may use an in-process governed dispatcher under A437.
articles.prohibition: FORBID:duplicate role definitions with changed semantics+sovereign execution+sub-sovereign implementation work+executor policy choice+status report as decision+role inferred from class name+transport mechanism defining authority.
articles.exception: A component may implement multiple technical interfaces only when activated under one role identity per request;role mixing inside one execution context remains forbidden.

articles.subject: canonical-identity-conversion-contract
articles.rule: IDENTITIES:tool_id,runtime_identity,module_architecture_code are distinct typed namespaces. FUNCTIONS:resolve_tool_id_to_runtime_identity(tool_id,registry_generation)->one current runtime identity or typed not-running/ambiguous error;resolve_runtime_identity_to_module_architecture_code(runtime_identity,generation)->exactly one module code;resolve_module_architecture_code_to_runtime_identities(module_code,generation)->ordered zero-to-many runtime identities. AUTHORITY:all conversions query permission-owned normalized registries through one resolver;no caller derives by casing,prefix,path,process name,port or string replacement. ROUNDTRIP:runtime-to-module is total for active runtime identities;tool-to-runtime is generation-scoped and may be absent;module-to-runtime is intentionally plural and not assumed reversible. OUTPUT:{input_namespace,input_id,output_namespace,output_ids,registry_generation,resolution_status,evidence_hash,expires_at_utc}. CACHE:key includes registry generation and invalidates on lifecycle change.
articles.prohibition: FORBID:cast/string-concatenation conversion+tool id equal runtime identity assumption+module code equal folder/process assumption+scalar module-to-runtime result+stale generation cache+silent first-match ambiguity+physical path as identity.
articles.exception: Offline validation may resolve immutable module architecture codes without a running runtime;it must return no runtime identity rather than fabricate one.

articles.subject: one-module-one-test-suite-schema
articles.rule: CARDINALITY:each architecture module has exactly one canonical logical test_suite_id;one suite is an aggregate record,not one file,one framework or one process. SCHEMA:test_suite_id+module_code+owner+suite_version+source_roots+test_unit_ids+language_runners+unit_test_sets+contract_test_sets+integration_membership+fixtures+mock_boundaries+entry_command_codes+required_gate_ids+coverage_scope+resource_budget+timeout+parallelism+environment_codes+evidence_root+status+introduced_at_utc+retired_at_utc+lineage. FILES:a suite may contain many files and native-language unit runners;cross-language integration remains pytest-owned. SUPPORT-ARTIFACTS:test,diagnostic,startup and one-time scripts obey language,line,ownership and security rules but do not each require independent runtime identity,health contract,sovereign chain or release pipeline unless they launch a persistent/privileged/independently deployable runtime. EXECUTION:save runs focused tests;precommit affected suite;integration/release required aggregate gates. OWNER:maintenance sub-sovereign centrally manages suite records;module owner supplies cases;executors run tests.
articles.prohibition: FORBID:multiple canonical suites per module+one physical test file claimed as whole suite+framework equals suite identity+support script forced into full runtime governance without trigger+diagnostic mutating production state+one-time script becoming recurring service+missing native unit runner+integration outside pytest.
articles.exception: A shared integration fixture belongs to a registered test-infrastructure module and may be referenced by many suites without becoming a second suite.

articles.subject: health-governance-outline
articles.rule: PURPOSE:replace monolithic A170 with independently provable contracts. COMPONENTS:A442 health contract schema+A443 observation and classification+A444 recovery orchestration. STATES:healthy|degraded|stale|reconcile_required|failed. OWNERSHIP:component owner emits signals;maintenance health management validates observations;decision sovereign decides health-impact policy;registered executor performs recovery;information layer carries contracts/status. PROOF:each component article has separate evidence and gate result;overall health never passes by averaging failed or missing required components.
articles.prohibition: FORBID:single monolithic health pass+subcontract skipped+health score replacing state+recovery evidence used as observation evidence+missing component treated healthy.
articles.exception: A module may declare a subset of dimensions only when the schema marks the others not-applicable with ownership and dependency proof.

articles.subject: health-contract-machine-verifiable-schema
articles.rule: SCHEMA:health_contract_id+schema_version+module_code+owner+runtime_identity_requirement+generation+dimensions+required_signals+signal_types+units+source_codes+sampling_or_event_mode+freshness_deadline_ms+warning_thresholds+failure_thresholds+hysteresis+debounce+dependency_codes+aggregation_rule+degraded_capabilities+recovery_objective+security_classification+contract_hash+effective_at_utc+status+lineage. SIGNAL:{signal_id,contract_id,module_code,runtime_identity-or-null,generation-or-null,dimension,value,unit,observed_at_utc,received_at_utc,sequence,source_code,quality,content_hash,correlation_id}. VALIDATION:JSON/typed envelope must exactly validate required fields,type,unit,range,time,generation,sequence and source;unknown required field/type/unit is contract-incompatible. Lightweight support artifacts use runtime_identity_requirement=NONE unless A481 SUPPORT-ARTIFACT-ESCALATION triggers.
articles.prohibition: FORBID:free-text-only health+implicit units+missing freshness/generation+threshold in checker source instead of contract+unknown signal counted healthy+support script forced to fabricate runtime identity+schema change without successor/version.
articles.exception: Optional diagnostic fields are allowed only in a versioned extension map and never affect health unless promoted into the schema.

articles.subject: health-observation-classification-contract
articles.rule: INPUT:A442 validated signals only. PROCESS:deduplicate>order>freshness check>dimension evaluation>dependency attribution>debounce/hysteresis>module classification. OUTPUT:{health_result_id,health_contract_id,module_code,generation,evaluated_at_utc,state,dimension_results,missing_or_stale_signals,dependency_impacts,capability_impacts,evidence_hashes,correlation_id,expires_at_utc}. RULE:failed required signal cannot be averaged away;stale and missing are explicit;dependency failure degrades only declared dependent capability and never changes owner attribution. PROBES:bounded and side-effect-free. OBSERVABILITY:state transition emits one typed event;unchanged samples may aggregate into bounded summaries.
articles.prohibition: FORBID:self-reported final health+single signal whole-module verdict+stale current+dependency fault reassigned to consumer+probe mutation+unbounded polling+score replacing dimension evidence+unchanged sample audit flood.
articles.exception: A health score may be displayed as non-authoritative monitoring only when the categorical state and every dimension remain visible.

articles.subject: health-recovery-orchestration-contract
articles.rule: TRIGGER:A443 state and exact fault codes. FLOW:detect>isolate>decide>authorize>execute>verify>stability-window>recover-or-escalate>audit. REQUEST:{recovery_id,module_code,generation,health_result_id,fault_codes,affected_capabilities,decision_id,authorization_proof,executor_code,resource_budget,attempt_budget,deadline,rollback_target,correlation_id}. RESULT:{recovery_id,state,attempts,before_hash,after_hash,verification_evidence,stability_window_result,remaining_faults,rollback_receipt,completed_at_utc}. POLICY:idempotent+bounded retries+backoff+circuit breaker+no source overwrite/reset+unaffected channels continue. Automatic repair/update user switches remain controlling where applicable. SUCCESS requires new A443 current classification after verification,not executor exit alone.
articles.prohibition: FORBID:recovery without current health result+component self-authorized repair+infinite retry+retry storm+whole-system isolation+success on process exit+reuse observation as verification+source reset/overwrite+hidden remaining fault.
articles.exception: A transient retry may reuse the same immutable request within its attempt budget;any target,decision or payload change requires a successor request.

articles.subject: formal-rule-contract-and-precedence-convergence
articles.rule: FORMALIZATION:natural-language provisions state intent but each machine-enforced invariant must bind one formal_rule_code with typed inputs,predicate,decision,severity,evidence schema,applicability,low-cost path and controlling provision. PRECEDENCE:exact special-law scope>later explicit successor>subordinate ordinance>general article;provision_reference_resolution_v2 records successor/clarification and special_law_conflict_matrix records scoped overrides;an unresolved apparent conflict is INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE,never left to checker interpretation. DEDUPLICATION:one formal rule owns each repeated boundary;other provisions reference its code and add only scoped fields. CHANGE:predicate or decision semantic change requires successor/version;checker code cannot invent policy. PROOF:formal evaluation records rule_code,input hashes,result,evidence ids,policy version and timestamp.
articles.prohibition: FORBID:natural-language substring as executable policy+same invariant implemented by multiple divergent checkers+precedence guessed from article number+later text silently overriding special law+unresolved conflict accepted+missing formal rule treated PASS.
articles.exception: Pure explanatory or historical text need not become executable,provided it cannot change a gate,permission,state or release decision.

articles.subject: execution-pipeline-contract-decomposition
articles.rule: PURPOSE:replace overloaded A69 with referenced stage contracts. PIPELINE:INTAKE>AUTHORIZE>PLAN>DISPATCH>EXECUTE>VERIFY>PUBLISH. EACH-STAGE has one owner,input schema,output schema,timeout,idempotency,fault codes and receipt type. ROLE:A438 controls decision/dispatch/execution;A437 controls whether stage transitions use pure calls,in-process governed dispatch or transport. VERIFY is independent from EXECUTE;PUBLISH uses information layer only when result crosses a governed boundary. SUPPORT:test,diagnostic,startup and one-time script may use a reduced pipeline INTAKE>EXECUTE>RESULT when it is owner-internal,read-only/non-privileged and leaves no governed state mutation;otherwise full applicable stages are restored.
articles.prohibition: FORBID:stage skip on governed mutation+executor self-authorization/self-verification+pipeline labels forcing transport+full runtime pipeline imposed on harmless owner-internal support helper+reduced path with privilege,state mutation,cross-owner I/O or persistent process.
articles.exception: A deterministic read-only owner-internal probe may combine intake,execute and result in one callable while preserving typed result and bounded timeout.

articles.subject: connection-boundary-and-low-cost-legal-paths
articles.rule: PURPOSE:replace overloaded A177. CONNECTION is an interaction crossing process,owner,trust,permission principal,state/data owner or independent contract boundary,or using I/O/serialization/session/transport handles. A437 PURE_INTERNAL_CALL and INTRA_MODULE_COMPONENT_CALL are not connections merely because code layers differ. ROUTES:LOCAL_PURE_CALL=no session/audit;LOCAL_GOVERNED_DISPATCH=typed envelope+scope+correlation without socket/IPC;READ_ONLY_QUERY=pooled least-scope session+prepared bounded query+batch audit;TEST_ISOLATED_ROUTE=ephemeral credentials+isolated data+no production mutation+aggregate evidence;FULL_TRANSPORT=information-layer adapter+auth+contract+timeout+retry/backpressure+audit. Selection uses formal predicates,not caller preference. Diagnostics,startup and one-time scripts choose the lowest route whose facts satisfy it and do not automatically require FULL_TRANSPORT.
articles.prohibition: FORBID:layer label alone classified connection+direct cross-owner I/O+read-only route performing mutation+test route touching production state+support script blanket bypass+FULL_TRANSPORT mandated when LOCAL_PURE_CALL predicate holds+low-cost route used across authority or data-owner boundary.
articles.exception: An in-process database-free read of immutable owner-local constants is LOCAL_PURE_CALL;an actual database query is READ_ONLY_QUERY even in the same process.

articles.subject: receipt-token-and-audit-event-machine-schemas
articles.rule: SCHEMAS:RECEIPT_V1,TOKEN_V1,AUDIT_EVENT_V1 are canonical machine contracts. RECEIPT binds receipt_id,operation_code,request_id,actor,executor,target,scope,generation,decision_id-or-null,idempotency_key,before/after revisions and hashes,result,fault codes,evidence hashes,started/completed timestamps,correlation_id,receipt_hash. TOKEN contains token_id,type,issuer,subject,audience,scope_codes,purpose,issued_at,not_before,expires_at,nonce,generation,policy_hash,revocation_generation,confirmation_id-or-null,signature reference,status;secret material is never persisted or audited. AUDIT_EVENT contains event_id,sequence,previous_event_hash,event_type,actor,role,operation,target,scope,result,fault_codes,evidence refs,revision_before/after,generation,occurred/recorded timestamps,correlation/causation ids,redaction class,event_hash. VALIDATION:exact schema/version,type,requiredness,hash,sequence,expiry and scope before use.
articles.prohibition: FORBID:free-form receipt/token/audit payload+token secret in persistence/log+receipt without target/result/hash+audit without sequence/hash chain+expired or wrong-generation token+generic success replacing typed receipt+schema inferred from producer implementation.
articles.exception: A no-op pure internal call needs no execution receipt;optional trace events remain non-authoritative and content-redacted.

articles.subject: technical-pass-versus-external-verification-status
articles.rule: STATUS:TECHNICAL_PASS|SEALED_PENDING_EXTERNAL_SIGNATURES|VERIFIED_RELEASE|REJECTED|INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE. Technical tests,gates,hashes and local seals can produce TECHNICAL_PASS only. Human-governor external threshold signatures and trust-anchor validation are mandatory before VERIFIED_RELEASE. Missing pending signatures never invalidate completed technical evidence but cannot be presented as formal verification,production authorization or verified release. UI/API/audit reports both technical_status and certification_status separately with exact missing requirements. Activation follows the controlling release policy and cannot silently treat pending as verified.
articles.prohibition: FORBID:test PASS labeled verified release+local/self signature replacing external signature+pending hidden from status+technical failure masked by valid signature+single combined boolean status+release promotion from TECHNICAL_PASS alone.
articles.exception: Development/test execution may consume TECHNICAL_PASS artifacts inside an isolated non-production scope when the release policy explicitly permits it and the pending certification is visible.

articles.subject: formal-rule-schema-registry-and-migration-gate
articles.rule: DIRECTORIES:DIR_FORMAL_RULE_REGISTRY and DIR_MACHINE_SCHEMA_REGISTRY are the sole queryable registries for executable governance predicates and machine contract schemas. CLASSIFICATION:every active provision is INTERPRETIVE_ONLY|MACHINE_ENFORCED|MIXED;each MACHINE_ENFORCED clause maps to one-or-more formal_rule_code and every formal rule maps one controlling provision plus explicit supporting provisions. MAPPING-STATUS:UNMAPPED|PARTIAL|MAPPED|CONFLICT|VERIFIED;natural text may explain intent but checker/gate/release decisions consume only VERIFIED formal rules whose policy version and evidence schema match current revision. UNMAPPED or CONFLICT machine enforcement is INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE,not inferred implementation behavior. SCHEMA-REGISTRY:each schema_code records schema_kind+semantic owner+required/optional fields+field types+nullability+version+compatibility+hash+persistence class+redaction+status+successor;receipt,token,health,audit,test-suite,identity-conversion and final-decision schemas register here without duplicating their field definitions in checkers. PRECEDENCE-ALGORITHM:collect applicable provisions by exact scope>resolve explicit successor chain>apply registered special-over-general conflict rows>apply subordinate ordinance under controlling law>require one effective controlling rule;zero or multiple unresolved results=CONFLICT. Article number,load order and source-code order have no precedence. MIGRATION:new or changed machine-enforced clauses require formal mapping before enforcement;existing unmapped clauses become bounded formalization debt with owner,severity,affected gates and deadline but cannot be silently treated verified. CRITICAL permission,identity,ABI,security,release and mutation boundaries block formal VERIFIED release while unmapped. LOW-COST-PROFILES:LOCAL_PURE_CALL,LOCAL_GOVERNED_DISPATCH,READ_ONLY_QUERY,TEST_ISOLATED_ROUTE,SUPPORT_LIGHTWEIGHT and FULL_TRANSPORT have registered predicates,required evidence and forbidden effects;the planner selects the least costly valid profile and escalates only when facts cross its boundary. CERTIFICATION:technical gate result and external signature state remain separate schema fields;SEALED_PENDING_EXTERNAL_SIGNATURES can never satisfy VERIFIED_RELEASE. PERFORMANCE:registry lookup uses exact indexed codes and cached immutable version/hash;policy change invalidates derived cache. HISTORY:revision_history remains user-deleted.
articles.prohibition: FORBID:checker parsing natural-language strings as policy+unmapped clause enforced as PASS/FAIL+duplicate formal rules for same predicate without precedence+schema fields hardcoded independently in producers/consumers+article-number precedence+special-law conflict guessed+low-cost route selected by caller preference+support route mutating governed state+technical PASS converted to VERIFIED+formalization debt hidden or grandfathered forever.
articles.exception: Interpretive-only provisions may remain natural language and searchable;they cannot independently block or authorize execution until a formal machine rule is explicitly registered.

articles.subject: execution-receipt-tier-profile
articles.rule: SUCCESSOR-SCOPE:A446 declares stage contracts;this article declares the canonical machine receipt-tier profile. TIERS:dispatch-intake|authorization-and-governance-gate|task-planning|specialized-executor|result-verification|state-event-audit-publication. MAPPING:INTAKE->dispatch-intake;AUTHORIZE->authorization-and-governance-gate;PLAN->task-planning;DISPATCH+EXECUTE->specialized-executor;VERIFY->result-verification;PUBLISH->state-event-audit-publication. ORDER:strict single pass;skip+repeat+out-of-order deny with a receipt error. REFUSALS:authorization failures still record planning+executor+verification+publication as refusal receipts;no tier is skipped. VERIFICATION:the verification actor must differ from the concrete specialized-executor actor whenever an executor actor is named;executor self-declared success is never sufficient. ACCEPTANCE:an accepted outcome requires a complete receipt ledger+a passing independent verdict+a published audit entry;any missing receipt+failed verdict or failed publication returns a refusal instead. DURABILITY:the audit append is serialized against concurrent processes and flushed to stable storage before success;an append that cannot be made durable denies.
articles.prohibition: FORBID:tier-skip+duplicate+reorder on governed work+executor self-verification+accepted outcome without complete receipts+basis-free acceptance+acceptance before audit publication+publication failure tolerated+reduced profile on state mutation
articles.exception: A decision-only adjudication that executes nothing records the same tier profile with the executor tier marked decision-layer;the receipt ledger is never reduced below the six declared tiers.

articles.subject: codex-official-read-session-and-attested-reader-schema
articles.rule: SCHEMA:CODEX_READ_SESSION_V1 is the registered machine contract for official-entry reads {session_nonce|requester_identity|identity_attestation|purpose_code|provision_scope|permission_review_id|issued_at|expires_at|single_use|codex_version}. AUTHORITATIVE-READS:every sovereign authoritative view passes governance-codex://official;the requester identity is bound to a single-use session minted by the entry owner (permission-sovereign) after per-request review;least provision scope;the nonce is consumed exactly once;expiry is bounded;replayed+expired+scope-widened or mismatched sessions deny. SELF-DECLARATION:a sovereign may self-mint only its own declaration read. AUDIT:metadata-only per attempt with result;content never enters audit. CHINESE-VIEW:star-only;permission-review-exempt;all other official-entry controls plus read-only remain. RESPONSE:typed+version-identified+requested-scope-only.
articles.prohibition: FORBID:bare-requester-string as identity+unbound session+scope beyond the declared provision+replay+expired reuse+self-minting for another sovereign's declaration+Chinese view by any non-star identity+content in audit+alternate entry+credential sharing
articles.exception: Import-time sovereign self-declaration uses the bounded self-attested session;it never waives nonce+expiry+single-use+scope or audit.

articles.subject: attested-execution-identity-derivation
articles.rule: DERIVATION:an execution identity is resolved from the authenticated shared-layer channel claimant and its sealed-registry binding:the requested tool manifest id equals the requested tool;the channel claimant is the sealed-registry governed identity;the registry-pinned bound manifest declares that identity when the claimant differs from the hosting owner;the module registry declares the exact execution identity for the resolved module architecture code. CONSISTENCY:all four values must agree before any governed execution;an unresolved+unattested or mismatched identity denies. SELF-DERIVATION:comparing two values derived from the same request input is not attestation and is forbidden.
articles.prohibition: FORBID:request-echoed execution identity+self-derived comparison+channel claimant outside the sealed registry+bound manifest that does not declare the channel identity+registry execution-identity mismatch+execution before four-way resolution+placeholder identity
articles.exception: A standalone single-tool runtime attests that tool's own chain;hosting-owner resolution applies only through the sealed-registry bound manifest,never through free text.

articles.subject: permission-decision-transport-and-append-only-ledger
articles.rule: DECISION-TRANSPORT:a denied+withheld or unreviewed permission decision returns a typed refused outcome;an accepted outcome never carries decision=denied;callers may not infer a grant from outcome acceptance alone. GRANT-LEDGER:issue+renew+restrict+suspend+revoke+terminate append to an append-only ledger with a sovereign-minted permission_id;the ledger is the source of truth across restarts;prior entries are never mutated or deleted;lifecycle transitions require a recorded issuance and a current second-key review;an unrecordable grant or transition denies. STATES:issued|renewed|restricted|suspended|revoked|terminated;terminal states remain visible in history.
articles.prohibition: FORBID:denial wrapped in an accepted outcome+caller-inferred grant+module-self-issued permission id+lifecycle without issuance record+lifecycle without current review+in-memory-only source of truth+ledger mutation+deletion+silent ledger failure
articles.exception: Immediate containment may suspend or revoke an exact permission before review;every grant+renewal or expansion still requires the two-key rule.

articles.subject: independent-verification-verdict-record
articles.rule: VERDICT:each verification produces a typed record {verified|verifier|reasons}. IDENTITY:the verifier is a distinct program object or identity from every executor actor;the recorded verifier differs from the concrete specialized-executor actor whenever one is named. CHECKS:the decision basis must be present;an executor may not declare its own verified state or verifier field;an unaccepted result must carry a refusal reason;registered per-intent checks add evidence checks. EVIDENCE:where a registered check verifies an artifact+revision+state or external evidence,the verdict references that evidence and never relies solely on executor-reported fields. FAIL-CLOSED:any failed check returns verified=false with reasons and the request is refused.
articles.prohibition: FORBID:self-verification+executor-self-declared verification accepted+verdict without reasons+basis-free acceptance+verifier equal to the concrete executor+one actor as sole final verifier of its own work+silent verdict omission
articles.exception: A decision-only adjudication with no concrete executor is verified by the independent verifier object;the verdict is still recorded.

articles.subject: user-authorized-revision-history-resumption-genesis
articles.rule: USER-AUTHORITY:the current explicit user finding that empty revision_history violates A79 authorizes revision recording to resume now under the separate-command exception of A414. NO-BACKFILL:previously user-deleted entries remain deleted and must not be reconstructed from Git,mirror,seals,caches or inference. NEW-GENESIS:revision_history begins a new auditable chain at sequence=1 whose previous_hash is 64 zero hexadecimal characters and whose summary explicitly names user-authorized-resumption-after-deletion;the entry binds the current successor version,current pre-amendment seal full_root as baseline and the exact amendment scope. It proves the new chain start,not undisclosed prior amendment history. FUTURE:every Codex successor transaction copies the complete resumed chain,appends exactly one current change entry before provision_revisions/sealing,and sets seal_manifest.history_head to that entry_hash;version,change_id,timestamp,scope,summary,previous_hash and entry_hash are mandatory. ENTRY-HASH:SHA256 over canonical UTF-8 fields sequence|change_id|version|recorded_at_utc|change_scope|summary|previous_hash|version_epoch with separators fixed by the registered canonicalization policy. ORDER:sequence strictly increases by one,previous_hash equals prior entry_hash,version and recorded_at are nondecreasing UTC timestamps,and one successor version has exactly one history entry. CURRENT-SCOPE-PRECEDENCE:this article supersedes A414 and overrides only the obsolete 'revision_history remains user-deleted/empty' clauses embedded in earlier and related active provisions;their non-history rules remain active. A79 again controls ordinary future history preservation. VALIDATION:empty history after this version,missing current entry,broken sequence/hash/version linkage,seal head mismatch or reconstructed pre-genesis entry is CRITICAL FAIL and blocks Codex publication. CERTIFICATION:the resumed chain is technical integrity evidence;external human signatures remain separately pending and are still required for VERIFIED_RELEASE.
articles.prohibition: FORBID:reconstructing deleted entries+claiming genesis contains prior history+sequence gap+multiple entries for one version+entry after seal+in-place history edit/delete/reorder+noncanonical hash+seal history_head mismatch+future amendment without append+user-deleted marker used to suppress future history+history chain used to imply external signature verification.
articles.exception: The deleted pre-genesis history remains permanently unavailable. Its absence is explicitly represented by the new genesis boundary and does not permit fabricated recovery.

articles.subject: single-chinese-codex-mirror-three-part-storage
articles.rule: LOGICAL-IDENTITY:the Chinese Codex remains exactly one non-authoritative confidential mirror under A173;it is stored as exactly three ordered physical parts,not three mirrors. PARTS:governance_codex.zh-TW.part-1.txt|part-2.txt|part-3.txt under the canonical Codex directory;the former unsplit file is retired and must not coexist. ENVELOPE:each part contains codex_version+mirror_id+part_index+part_count=3+previous_part_hash+assembled_payload_hash+tables+part_hash. ORDER:part_index exactly 1,2,3;part-1 previous hash is 64 zeroes;each later previous hash equals prior part_hash. HASH:part_hash is SHA256 of canonical UTF-8 envelope excluding part_hash;assembled_payload_hash is SHA256 of the canonical reassembled {codex_version,tables} payload and is identical in all parts. ASSEMBLY:authorized 星澄 review and structural audit load all three,validate identity/version/count/order/chain/part hashes/assembled hash,then merge table row fragments in part order in memory only;no fourth persistent assembled copy,cache,backup,RAG index or export is permitted. ATOMIC-PUBLICATION:Codex amendment writes three candidate parts under one generation,verifies full parity with authoritative SQLite,then atomically promotes the complete set;missing,mixed-version,duplicate,extra or corrupt part makes the Chinese mirror unavailable without affecting authoritative SQLite or active runtime. ACCESS:A173+A435 confidentiality,identity,scope,session and metadata-only audit controls remain unchanged;file splitting grants no additional viewer,authority,citation or disclosure. PROTECTION:all three parts share the same read-only/protected classification and lifecycle;cleanup treats them as one set and never deletes an individual active part. LINEAGE-CLOSURE:every provision identity including A426 onward has a provision_lineage row binding introduced_by,status,content hash and predecessor where declared;lineage count equals identity count in the current seal. HISTORY:the resumed revision_history chain appends this amendment and remains hash-linked from A456 genesis.
articles.prohibition: FORBID:three independent mirror identities+retaining unsplit mirror+fourth manifest containing full content+persisted assembled copy+partial-part access presented complete+part reorder+mixed version+missing chain/hash validation+Chinese content in logs/index/RAG+non-星澄 content access+one-part update+lineage count mismatch+amendment without revision-history append.
articles.exception: A streaming authorized reader may hold bounded transient rows while assembling;all transient content is erased at session end and never becomes another persistent mirror.

articles.subject: bidirectional-multiplexed-channel-special-law
articles.rule: DIRECTION:every canonical information channel supports governed bidirectional request,response,event,acknowledgement,cancellation,health and recovery traffic over one typed transport contract; either endpoint may originate an authorized message without reversing ownership or permission boundaries. MULTIPLEXING:one physical connection may carry multiple isolated logical streams concurrently; every frame binds channel_code,connection_generation,stream_id,message_id,correlation_id,sequence,direction,operation_id,schema_version,deadline,priority and authorization_context. ORDERING:sequence is strict per stream; no global ordering is implied across independent streams; response,event and acknowledgement preserve correlation. FLOW-CONTROL:each stream has bounded queue,window,rate,budget,timeout,cancellation and backpressure; congestion or failure in one stream is isolated and cannot block healthy streams. FAIRNESS:priority scheduling reserves capacity for control,health and recovery traffic while preventing starvation. RECONNECT:reconnection creates a new connection generation, resumes only acknowledged resumable streams from durable checkpoints, rejects stale frames and deduplicates idempotency keys. HALF-CLOSE:each direction may close independently; final channel shutdown occurs only after both directions close or a governed fatal isolation decision. SECURITY:authentication,authorization,classification and audit apply per logical stream and message,not merely per socket. OWNERSHIP:information-layer owns information truth and service;shared-layer implements transport and contracts;automation-sovereign operates and maintains channels;permission-sovereign decides access;decision/runtime sovereigns do not intervene;星澄 may traverse within its lawful privilege but cannot bypass per-stream controls.
articles.prohibition: FORBID:single-direction-only canonical channel+head-of-line blocking across independent streams+shared sequence across unrelated streams+cross-stream identity/permission/evidence reuse+unbounded streams or queues+silent frame loss+stale-generation acceptance+automatic code overwrite/reset during recovery+failure propagation to healthy streams+connection-level authorization substituted for per-stream authorization.
articles.exception: A strictly one-way external protocol may use one direction only when its registered adapter still exposes the canonical bidirectional contract and explicitly marks the unavailable direction; this exception creates no second transport authority.

articles.subject: sovereign-multicore-parallel-collaboration-special-law
articles.rule: SCOPE:decision-sovereign,runtime-sovereign,automation-sovereign and independent privileged institutions may deliberate,review,coordinate and exchange evidence concurrently through isolated logical work units;parallelism does not grant execution power to a sovereign that lacks it. DECISION-SOVEREIGN:parallel analysis is joined into one deterministic decision and never becomes module execution. RUNTIME-SOVEREIGN:parallel readiness,health and lifecycle coordination is joined before dispatch and never performs module work. SYNCHRONIZATION-SOVEREIGN:may run bounded multicore channel,update,synchronization,backup,repair,cleanup and logging coordination only within its expressly executable privileges. PERMISSION-SOVEREIGN:parallel permission and audit-verification checks remain independent from execution and converge into one permission result. 星澄:may perform privileged parallel analysis,review,automation coordination and lawful native execution under its special law. SUB-SOVEREIGNS:may parallelize dispatch planning,module supervision and evidence collection but possess no actual module execution power. MODULE-EXECUTION:actual work remains with registered module executors. SCHEDULING:eligible CPU work uses adaptive bounded multicore workers;I/O work uses bounded asynchronous concurrency;capacity reserves protect UI,channels,database and recovery paths. ISOLATION:each work unit has task_id,owner,active_role,generation,scope,permission,resource budget,deadline,cancellation,checkpoint and receipt. JOIN:dependencies form an acyclic graph;mandatory branches verify before deterministic stable-order convergence. FAILURE:a failed worker or branch is quarantined,retried or degraded independently while healthy collaboration continues. CONFLICT:shared mutable targets and irreversible effects serialize under one lawful transaction or lock owner.
articles.prohibition: FORBID:sovereign execution by relabeling parallel analysis+sub-sovereign module execution+unbounded worker creation+use of every core without reserve+shared mutable state without ownership+cross-task credential/evidence reuse+nondeterministic merge+completion before mandatory join+fault cascade+parallel conflicting decisions presented as multiple authority results.
articles.exception: Emergency capacity reduction may serialize work without violating the collaboration contract;serialization changes throughput only and never transfers authority.

articles.subject: independent-tool-complete-modularization-special-law
articles.rule: MANDATE:every independent tool is a self-contained modular system inside the registered STANDALONE_TOOLS_ROOT and its own registered tool root;all authored source,UI,backend,contracts,adapters,data access,configuration,assets,tests,diagnostics,maintenance,update and lifecycle code belong to explicit modules with one primary responsibility and declared owner,interface,dependencies,state boundary,fault boundary and test suite. LAYERS:each tool declares entry/UI,application orchestration,domain semantics,infrastructure adapters,transport contracts,state/data and tests where applicable;absent layers are declared not-applicable and are not replaced by hidden cross-tool dependencies. ISOLATION:a tool owns its process,window,lifecycle,private state and bounded degraded mode;its failure,close,restart,repair or update cannot terminate,reset or overwrite the main system or another tool. DEPENDENCIES:cross-module calls use typed internal interfaces;cross-tool or cross-layer traffic uses the canonical information/shared-layer contract;no module imports another tool's private implementation. SIZE:every module,file,class and function obeys the registered line limits and self-splits before exceeding them;split modules preserve one public contract and acyclic dependency graph. TESTING:one registered test suite per tool module follows the test-suite schema and is centrally managed by the maintenance sub-sovereign. CONFIGURATION:paths use registered directory codes and dynamic resolution;environment-dependent values use registered environment-variable codes;timestamps alone may be literal under the timestamp article. MIGRATION:a completed modular architecture removes superseded roots,duplicate entrypoints,shadow services and obsolete compatibility implementations only after evidence-preserving migration and governed cleanup. LIFECYCLE:UI close requests orderly cancellation,flush,receipt and termination of that tool's backend only.
articles.prohibition: FORBID:monolithic independent-tool implementation+source outside its registered top-level root+hidden shared mutable state+direct import of another tool's private code+duplicate backend or entrypoint+one module owning unrelated responsibilities+line-limit bypass by generated wrappers+unregistered script or test+hard-coded physical path+tool failure propagation+UI orphaning its backend+new architecture retaining an active old root.
articles.exception: Generated and third-party artifacts remain separately classified and need not follow authored-source module layout, but must stay in registered artifact/vendor boundaries and cannot own domain behavior.

articles.subject: sovereign-subsovereign-direct-information-layer-route
articles.rule: DIRECT-ROUTE:a sovereign and any lawfully attached sub-sovereign may address each other directly without an intermediary sovereign,while every message still enters the canonical information-layer service and is carried only by the shared-layer typed transport implementation. ROUTE:sovereign identity -> information-layer authorization+contract+correlation -> shared-layer logical stream -> attached sub-sovereign identity,and the reverse path uses the same contract. BIDIRECTIONAL:request,response,event,acknowledgement,cancellation,health,dispatch-status and evidence may originate from either endpoint within its role. BOUNDARY:direct means logical endpoint selection only;it never means in-process bypass,direct filesystem/database access,private import,unaudited IPC or authority inheritance. VALIDATION:each stream proves current attachment,active identity,role,scope,permission,generation,schema,deadline,sequence and correlation before delivery. AUTHORITY:the sovereign retains only its declared decision or privileged power;the sub-sovereign retains dispatch,module-management and coordination duties and gains no module execution power. INFORMATION-OWNERSHIP:information-layer owns information service and routing truth;shared-layer implements channel and contract;automation-sovereign operates and maintains transport;permission-sovereign decides access. ISOLATION:one sovereign-sub-sovereign stream has its own queue,budget,backpressure,checkpoint and fault domain;failure cannot interrupt unrelated streams. TOPOLOGY:attachment is resolved dynamically from the registered hierarchy and identity generation,never from hard-coded physical addresses.
articles.prohibition: FORBID:direct-call bypass of information-layer+private cross-boundary method/import used as transport+permission inheritance from attachment+sub-sovereign execution+unregistered attachment+hard-coded endpoint+cross-stream credential/evidence reuse+uncorrelated response+stale-generation delivery+failure propagation.
articles.exception: A pure call wholly inside one process,module,owner,trust,principal,generation and state-owner remains an internal implementation call under the call-boundary rule;once sovereign or sub-sovereign identities differ,this direct-route article applies.

articles.subject: provision-normativity-classification-contract
articles.rule: CLASSIFICATION:every provision identity must declare exactly one current primary class:EXPLANATORY,HISTORICAL,NORMATIVE_MANUAL,MACHINE_ENFORCED,RELEASE_BLOCKING or SUPERSEDED;secondary tags may refine but never replace the primary class. EXPLANATORY creates no independent duty. HISTORICAL is non-effective lineage evidence. NORMATIVE_MANUAL requires named verifier and evidence schema. MACHINE_ENFORCED requires an active formal-rule mapping,typed inputs,deterministic predicate,decision,severity and executable conformance evidence. RELEASE_BLOCKING requires fresh revision-bound evidence and denies release on failure or absence. SUPERSEDED must resolve to one active successor. DEFAULT:an unclassified active provision is NORMATIVE_MANUAL and INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE,never silently machine-enforced or release-passing. COVERAGE:formal-rule count need not equal provision count,but every machine-enforced clause must be mapped and every mapping must resolve to one active provision and evaluator contract.
articles.prohibition: FORBID:implicit normative class+checker-created policy+unmapped machine enforcement+missing evidence treated as pass+superseded rule remaining controlling+one mapping claiming unrelated clauses.
articles.exception: Legacy provisions remain readable;their classification is migrated incrementally and cannot be inferred as verified release evidence.

articles.subject: formal-rule-semantic-and-evaluator-parity-contract
