articles.rule: CALL-BOUNDARY:compare caller and callee values field-by-field for process,module,owner,trust,principal,generation and state_owner;never compare heterogeneous namespaces to one another. ROLE:each request carries active_role_identity;星澄 may lawfully use review,coordination or executor role under its special law while one request has exactly one active role and retains permission/domain boundaries. IDENTITY:resolver proof validates registry hash,current generation,active source and output identities,declared cardinality and certified resolver receipt. HEALTH:validate schema,type,unit,range,time,freshness,dimension,threshold,hysteresis,sequence,generation,source and content hash. PRECEDENCE:prove exactly one controlling rule,acyclic successor graph,valid special-law containment,ordinance authority and superseded predecessor exclusion. PIPELINE:validate exact order,uniqueness,stage owner,input/output schema,timeout,idempotency,fault code,receipt and executor-verifier separation. TRANSPORT:FULL_TRANSPORT validates authenticated requester,registered destination,scope,contract,rate budget,audit,transport owner and credential custody;it is never unconditional. MACHINE-SCHEMA:validate types,enums,timestamps,hashes,sequence,previous hash,signature references,schema version and unknown-field policy. RELEASE:verify actual Ed25519 threshold signatures,signer identities,trust anchors,artifact digest,content root,history head and identity root;status strings alone are evidence claims,not proof. PARITY:formal registry predicate,evaluator behavior,tests and controlling prose must share one versioned semantic hash;any mismatch is CRITICAL and fail-closed.
articles.prohibition: FORBID:heterogeneous-ID equality+role hard-code that removes lawful 星澄 executor identity+cardinality-only identity proof+field-presence-only health/schema proof+stage-name-only pipeline proof+unconditional FULL_TRANSPORT+self-asserted release verification+evaluator semantics without Codex lineage.
articles.exception: Until evaluator parity evidence is submitted,the technical audit may report structural checks but affected formal decisions remain INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE.

articles.subject: seal-candidate-certification-and-release-status-contract
articles.rule: IDENTITY:each seal record is either CANDIDATE_SEAL,CERTIFIED_SEAL or RETIRED_SEAL and binds a unique seal_id,version_identity,content_root,history_head,identity_root,lineage_root,created_at and certification state. IMMUTABILITY:a changed root or history head creates a new candidate identity and never overwrites a sealed identity. CERTIFICATION:Ed25519 2-of-3 external signatures and valid trust anchors are mandatory for CERTIFIED_SEAL. STATUS:technical output is standardized as TECHNICAL_AUDIT_PASS or TECHNICAL_AUDIT_FAIL;legal closure is CODEX_CERTIFICATION_COMPLETE or CODEX_CERTIFICATION_INCOMPLETE;release is VERIFIED_RELEASE_APPROVED or VERIFIED_RELEASE_DENIED. A technical pass with pending signatures always yields CODEX_CERTIFICATION_INCOMPLETE and VERIFIED_RELEASE_DENIED. HISTORY:the post-deletion revision chain begins at its declared recovery genesis and proves only successors from that genesis;it must not claim reconstructed deleted history. OBLIGATIONS:mandated,planned,in-progress,evidence-submitted,verified,complete,escalated and failed remain distinct;an incomplete release-blocking obligation denies affected verified release and is never promoted by audit wording.
articles.prohibition: FORBID:same seal identity with changed roots+candidate represented as certified+technical PASS presented as legal verification+signature status string substituted for cryptographic proof+fabricated deleted history+mandated obligation presented complete.
articles.exception: Historical seal rows lacking candidate identity remain legacy candidate evidence only and cannot certify a current release.

articles.subject: active-identity-metadata-and-dynamic-location-contract
articles.rule: IDENTITY-METADATA:current viewer,actor,owner and route metadata is derived from the active identity and hierarchy registries at the current generation;retired,abolished or superseded identities are excluded from active lists and retained only in lineage. CHINESE-MIRROR:its content viewer remains exclusively 星澄 regardless of generic machine-Codex metadata. LOCATION:physical values already governed by a directory entry are referenced by architecture,directory,tool,module,command,fault or environment code and resolved dynamically through the registered current-generation resolver;duplicate physical literals outside the authoritative directory are invalid. TIMESTAMP:only timestamp fields may contain literal time values under the timestamp format article;version identity and timestamps remain separate typed fields. AUDIT:permission-sovereign verifies authorization and audit integrity;星澄 reviews Codex-versus-implementation conformity and reports issue class,rule,code,path and detailed evidence without generic findings.
articles.prohibition: FORBID:retired identity in active metadata+Chinese mirror viewer expansion+duplicated hard-coded physical path+timestamp used as an untyped substitute for another field+generic finding without exact file or registered target.
articles.exception: A directory's authoritative physical_root field may contain the resolved physical value as the single source of truth;all consumers use its code.

articles.subject: codex-derived-registry-index-and-identity-classification-closure
articles.rule: CURRENT-REGISTRIES:entity classification,provision normativity,module manifests,search manifests,formal mappings and activation references are derived current-state registries;each amendment that changes their inputs rebuilds them in the same candidate generation before seal publication. ENTITY:active identity classification is derived from the current sovereign and hierarchy registries;法典 is a non-sovereign rule layer;permission-sovereign and 星澄 are independent privileged institutions;星澄 additionally retains own-domain sovereign identity;retired and abolished identities remain historical only. NORMATIVITY:every provision identity has exactly one row in provision_normativity_classification with primary class,verifier,evidence schema,release-blocking flag,version and status. FORMAL-TRUTH:a formal mapping or evaluator with unproven current semantic parity is DECLARED_PENDING_EVALUATOR_PARITY,never VERIFIED;the affected decision fails closed as INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE. MANIFEST-FRESHNESS:module membership counts,lifecycle counts,classification hashes,content hashes,dependency hashes,FTS rows,aliases and search roots must equal current authoritative rows and version identity. LOCATION:activation state references architecture codes;only the authoritative architecture directory stores the physical root literal. ATOMICITY:SQLite authority,derived registries,search index,module manifests,seal and the three-part Chinese mirror publish as one candidate generation or remain unavailable as a set.
articles.prohibition: FORBID:stale manifest marked sealed+retired entity classified active+星澄 denied its exclusive Chinese mirror+formal mapping marked VERIFIED without semantic parity evidence+duplicate physical root outside its authoritative directory+search count/hash from an earlier version+partial derived-registry publication.
articles.exception: A cache may retain prior derived data only with its source and policy hashes and must be discarded or rebuilt before current-generation adjudication.

articles.subject: investment-mobile-standalone-root-correction
articles.rule: CORRECTION:INVESTMENT_MOBILE is a direct child of STANDALONE_TOOLS and resolves to the registered independent-tool root under STANDALONE_TOOLS_ROOT;the former AI_ASSISTANT child location is superseded and is not an active or legacy implementation root. IDENTITY:investment-mobile remains one independent tool and does not become part of the ai-assistant tool. ACTIVATION:architecture activation resolves ARCH_CODE:INVESTMENT_MOBILE through the corrected project architecture directory and must verify the physical root exists before active status. CLEANUP:no compatibility alias,duplicate service,shadow data root or second runtime identity may remain at the former location.
articles.prohibition: FORBID:parent AI_ASSISTANT+old nested physical root+two investment-mobile identities+silent locator fallback to former path.
articles.exception: Historical evidence may retain the former path only as a superseded non-resolvable value.

articles.subject: directory-governance-data-closure-and-three-stage-acceptance-gate
articles.rule: DISTINCTION:PHYSICAL_STRUCTURAL_ACTIVE proves only that a registered root or structure exists;GOVERNANCE_ACCEPTANCE_COMPLETE proves identity,permission,interface,dependency,lifecycle,test,resource,observability and failure-injection evidence;VERIFIED_RELEASE requires governance acceptance plus every release-blocking gate and external certification. None implies another. DIRECTORY-CLOSURE:every directory in directory_master_catalog is a formal governance data product,not documentation;active requires schema,owner,code identity,relationships,authoritative rows,persistence,read/write boundary,lookup API,validation,test,audit,lineage and acceptance evidence. PENDING:any mandated-pending-implementation directory is unavailable as authority and every dependent decision is INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE. CORE-BLOCKERS:DIR_IDENTITY_MODULE,DIR_PERMISSION_CAPABILITY,DIR_TOOL_ROUTE,DIR_DATA_SCHEMA_AUTHORITY,DIR_API_EVENT_CONTRACT,DIR_IDENTITY_GROUP,DIR_SOVEREIGN_HIERARCHY and DIR_MODULE_ASSIGNMENT are critical release-blocking governance dependencies. ACCEPTANCE:system_modularization_acceptance is authoritative for module governance closure;architecture_activation_states cannot substitute for it. EVIDENCE:each module acceptance binds current revision and exact identity,permission,interface,dependency,lifecycle,test,resource,observability and failure-injection evidence;missing or stale dimension keeps mandated-pending-activation-evidence. SUMMARY:machine-readable closure state reports counts and exact pending codes but never promotes state automatically. RELEASE:technical audit may pass while directory,module,signature or confidentiality gates remain incomplete;result remains CODEX_CERTIFICATION_INCOMPLETE and VERIFIED_RELEASE_DENIED.
articles.prohibition: FORBID:physical existence presented as governance acceptance+active architecture row used as release proof+pending directory used as authority+aggregate count without exact pending identities+missing evidence treated pass+automatic promotion without verifier receipt+technical audit wording that implies verified release.
articles.exception: A structural-only Codex module may use explicit not-applicable evidence dimensions only when its acceptance schema authorizes them and the verifier proves no runtime or data authority is concealed.

articles.subject: codex-external-non-indexing-and-internal-derived-search-clean-successor
articles.rule: SUCCESSOR:A469 completely supersedes A379. EXTERNAL-NON-INDEXING:Codex and every derivative are prohibited from RAG,embedding,semantic/vector indexes,training,external search,OS indexing and application-wide indexes. INTERNAL-SEARCH:authorized tooling may maintain codex_search_document,codex_search_alias,codex_search_fts,codex_search_index_manifest,codex_search_benchmark_evidence and module manifests only inside protected authoritative SQLite;they are local,read-only,rebuildable,non-authoritative,version-bound and sealed under A422,A423,A466. They support exact lookup,authorized full-text,filtering,precedence and integrity only and cannot change authority. Index access inherits source classification;Chinese mirror parts may mirror these tables but may not be separately indexed.
articles.prohibition: FORBID:Codex RAG/embedding/training/external indexing+unprotected index copy+derived index as authority+unauthorized snippet+Chinese mirror re-indexing.
articles.exception: Bounded authorized in-memory lookup is erased at session end.

articles.subject: directory-coverage-requirement-complete-alignment
articles.rule: Every directory_master_catalog identity has exactly one directly corresponding coverage requirement after canonical normalization. Coverage proves complete inventory,zero orphan,zero missing,current-version parity,authoritative rows and seal/hash coverage. DIR_TEST_SUITE_ARCHITECTURE,DIR_CODEX_INTERNAL_MODULE,DIR_FORMAL_RULE_REGISTRY and DIR_MACHINE_SCHEMA_REGISTRY are explicit release-blocking subjects.

articles.subject: revision-history-current-and-pre-genesis-state-normalization

articles.subject: language-governance-freeze-acceptance-event

Metadata alone cannot freeze.
articles.prohibition: FORBID:metadata-only freeze+self-declared FROZEN+missing or stale evidence+critical waiver.

articles.subject: epoch-two-canonical-identity-and-seal-authority
articles.rule: codex_version_epochs is canonical epoch identity authority and contains one active E2 row. epoch_seal_manifest binds E2,version identity,history head,counts and roots. Metadata,certification evidence,seal_manifest and epoch tables agree exactly. Empty epoch tables with active E2 metadata are invalid. Retirement requires explicit successor. E2 remains pending external signatures.

articles.exception: Pre-genesis legacy history head may be registered but never reconstructed.

articles.subject: lifecycle-lineage-reference-and-multi-predecessor-contract
articles.rule: STATE-PARITY:provision_lifecycle_status.lifecycle_state and provision_lineage.status must agree for every identity at the current generation;transition updates both atomically. REFERENCE_V2 columns are fixed as predecessor_type,predecessor_id,declared_successor_identity,resolved_successor_type,resolved_active_successor_id,resolution_path,status,validated_at_utc and each value validates its namespace. MULTI-EDGE:provision_supersession_edges is authoritative for zero-to-many and many-to-one succession;provision_lineage.supersedes_id is only a compatibility shortcut for at most one primary predecessor and cannot represent complete ancestry. Resolution proves every predecessor edge reaches exactly one active successor without cycles. AUTHORITY-BOUNDARY:provision_supersession_edges is the only current provision-succession source;supersession_registry is non-authoritative for provisions and is limited to legacy sovereign,alias and historical lookup.
articles.prohibition: FORBID:lifecycle/lineage drift+shifted reference fields+identity stored in type field+single supersedes_id claimed complete for multi-predecessor succession+orphan/cyclic edge.
articles.exception: A successor with one predecessor may repeat that predecessor in supersedes_id,provided the edge table agrees.

articles.subject: A233-special-law-normalization-complete-closure
articles.rule: NORMALIZATION:every provision_special_law_migration row with controlling law,migration status,owner and provision identity is normalized under A233 after bidirectional identity,law existence,owner and lifecycle validation. No row may remain pending-A233-normalization after this certified bulk closure. Evidence records source count,validated count,zero failures,current revision and digest. Future provisions normalize in the creating amendment transaction.
articles.prohibition: FORBID:permanent pending normalization+normalized without law/owner/identity validation+count-only evidence+new provision published before normalization.
articles.exception: A failed row remains explicit failed-normalization and blocks its dependent scope rather than being silently skipped.

articles.subject: current-seal-component-and-trust-anchor-continuity
articles.rule: CURRENT-SEAL:every current seal_manifest row has same-version sealed_components inventory and trust_anchor_requirements row. COMPONENTS bind authoritative content,identity,lineage,revision history,directory/registry state,search/module manifests,epoch identity and epoch seal into full-root coverage;included flags are explicit. TRUST:current row declares Ed25519,2-of-3,three keys,detached signatures and external offline private-key custody. CONTINUITY:seal,components,trust anchor,certification evidence and epoch seal share current version identity;missing current rows yield INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE. Historical legacy rows may remain sparse but cannot certify current release.
articles.prohibition: FORBID:manifest-only current seal+trust inherited implicitly from old version+component gap hidden by full-root string+private key stored in Codex+pending signature presented verified.
articles.exception: External signatures remain pending until real detached signature verification;adding the trust requirement row is not certification.

articles.subject: registered-bounded-codex-proxy-clean-successor
articles.rule: SUCCESSOR:A477 completely supersedes A91 and A103. ACCESS:registered sovereigns and a registered bounded Codex proxy may use governance-codex://official read-only through permission-authorized scope. A proxy is an adapter identity,not a sovereign,sub-sovereign,executor or delegated credential holder;it may retrieve only requested provisions and submit amendment candidates,diffs and evidence. It has no seal,certification,adjudication,authorization,decision,execution,activation or direct database power. PRECEDENCE:this explicit bounded exception is part of the controlling rule and no longer depends on more-specific-rule inference.
articles.prohibition: FORBID:anonymous/direct database access+proxy authority inheritance+credential delegation+scope expansion+proxy decision/execution+silent A91/A103 conflict resolution.
articles.exception: Certified audit tooling retains its separate metadata/integrity read profile.

articles.subject: codex-normative-authority-terminology-clean-successor
articles.rule: SUCCESSOR:A478 completely supersedes A29. TERMINOLOGY:Codex is the highest normative authority and rule declaration layer only;it is never operational authority and has no identity,decision,execution,authorization,adjudication,command or control power. Runtime actors apply Codex through their own registered authority and receipts. The phrase operational-authority is retired for Codex and may describe only an active registered runtime institution within its scope.
articles.prohibition: FORBID:calling Codex operational authority+deriving runtime power from normative rank+Codex as active sovereign or executor.
articles.exception: Codex integrity enforcement by tooling is execution owned by that tooling,not power exercised by Codex.

articles.subject: provision-classification-and-formal-parity-clean-successor
articles.rule: SUCCESSOR:A479 completely supersedes A450 classification and mapping-status clauses;A462 primary classes are canonical:EXPLANATORY,HISTORICAL,NORMATIVE_MANUAL,MACHINE_ENFORCED,RELEASE_BLOCKING,SUPERSEDED. Enforcement and release-blocking are orthogonal secondary tags,so A449 may be primary RELEASE_BLOCKING and also formal-rule mapped. MAPPING_STATUS is structural only:UNMAPPED,PARTIAL,MAPPED,CONFLICT. PARITY_STATUS is separate:NOT_APPLICABLE,PENDING,PASS,FAIL. A mapped rule is executable for formal VERIFIED decisions only when parity PASS binds registry,evaluator,test and controlling-prose semantic hashes plus evidence ID at current revision. Pending parity yields INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE.
articles.prohibition: FORBID:legacy INTERPRETIVE_ONLY/MIXED as current primary class+parity encoded in mapping status+MAPPED interpreted VERIFIED+one field carrying two state machines.
articles.exception: Legacy A450 classifications are historical migration inputs only.

articles.subject: machine-schema-complete-typed-registry-contract
articles.rule: Every machine schema row declares required fields,optional fields,field_types,nullability,schema_version,compatibility,unknown-field policy,content hash,persistence,redaction,status and successor. machine_schema_registry is the sole canonical machine-schema representation;specialized schema tables are derived views only and MUST NOT independently define semantics. Canonical producer schemas,consumer validators,derived specialized views and persistence tables must match one registered semantic hash before parity_status may be PASS. IDENTITY_CONVERSION_V1 is mandatory alongside receipt,token,audit,health,test-suite,final-decision,Codex-read-session and Chinese-mirror-part schemas. Drift,missing type/nullability evidence or absent producer-validator-table parity evidence is P0 INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE.
articles.prohibition: FORBID:key-name-only validation+checker-local field definitions+required/optional ambiguity+required-but-nullable hidden as optional+schema drift treated pass.
articles.exception: An explicitly optional field may be absent;nullable is independent and must be declared.

articles.subject: executable-module-test-suite-cardinality-clean-successor
articles.rule: SUCCESSOR:A481 supersedes only the cardinality clause of A440;all other A440 duties are incorporated here and remain current through A481. CARDINALITY:exactly one canonical logical aggregate test suite per executable architecture module;structural and declaration-only modules require explicit not-applicable-structural evidence. SCHEMA/OWNER:the canonical suite record retains A440 fields and is centrally managed by the maintenance sub-sovereign while the module owner supplies cases. SUPPORT-ARTIFACT-ESCALATION:test,diagnostic,startup and one-time scripts do not require independent runtime identity,health contract,sovereign chain or release pipeline unless persistent,privileged or independently deployable. EXECUTION:native focused tests and affected precommit suite run before aggregate integration/release gates. Shared test infrastructure may be referenced without becoming a second suite.
articles.prohibition: FORBID:suite required for non-executable container+executable module without exactly one suite+planned suite presented active+one suite mapped to multiple modules.
articles.exception: Shared test infrastructure may be referenced without becoming another module suite.

articles.subject: normalized-test-flow-command-fault-manual-trace-contract
articles.rule: Test-flow requirement_ids contains provision identities only. Exact command,fault and manual relationships are stored in normalized test_flow_command_links,test_flow_fault_links and test_flow_manual_links. test_trace_applicability is the sole machine-readable applicability registry and records code_type,code,relationship_type,applicability,reason_code,controlling_provision,evidence_hash,validated_at_version and status. Each link binds code,test flow,evidence field,evidence hash,introduced_version,validated_against_version and status. Active codes require either current validated links or an authorized current not-applicable record;pending,gap,retired and not-applicable are distinct states and missing data never means not applicable. FAULT_TO_MANUAL is zero-to-many with rationale;repairable faults require one-or-more manuals.
articles.prohibition: FORBID:mixed identity types in requirement_ids+free-text-only trace+every fault forced to arbitrary manual+repairable fault without manual+aggregate coverage without exact links.
articles.exception: Informational/non-repairable faults may have zero manuals only with registered rationale.

articles.subject: canonical-command-permission-action-contract
articles.rule: Every command permission_action is exactly action:target using the registered action and target identities;display names,hyphenated approximations and inferred values are invalid. SYS_GPTBRIDGE_START is start:main-system. Registration validates the permission capability directory and command contract before dispatch.
articles.prohibition: FORBID:permission_action without colon+display-name permission+action or target mismatch+dispatch before permission resolution.
articles.exception: A versioned alias may be accepted only during a registered migration window and resolves to one canonical action:target.

articles.subject: desktop-exe-sole-main-system-user-startup-entry
articles.rule: MAIN-SYSTEM-USER-ENTRY:MAIN_SYSTEM_DESKTOP_EXE is the sole production user-facing startup entry and resolves dynamically through the registered architecture/directory identity; FORM:the entry is the governed desktop native executable, while a desktop shortcut is only a locator to that same identity and never a second entry; FLOW:desktop EXE>visible UI shell>typed SYS_GPTBRIDGE_START intent>information layer>startup-sub-sovereign management>registered module executor; LAUNCHER:LAUNCHER is the internal startup-core boundary contained by MAIN_SYSTEM and is not the user-facing entry,not an independent executable authority and not a second startup path; BOUNDARY:the desktop EXE may create or focus the UI and submit typed intent only; it cannot decide startup,perform governance checks directly,wake a backend directly or own runtime state; PROFILE:CLI,service,test,development and maintenance entry profiles are separately registered non-production interfaces and cannot claim main-system user-entry status; IDENTITY:no physical EXE filename or absolute path is normative; permission-governed resolution binds MAIN_SYSTEM_DESKTOP_EXE to one current artifact,content hash,platform,generation and SYS_GPTBRIDGE_START contract; LIFECYCLE:single-instance,generation correlation,ten-second startup deadline,UI-close backend termination and audit receipt remain controlled by A193+A194+A199+A265.
articles.prohibition: FORBID:launcher-as-user-entry+script/VBS/CLI/service/dev-host as production user entry+multiple production EXE entries+direct EXE-to-backend wake+renderer startup authority+hardcoded physical EXE path in law+shortcut treated as authority+entry bypass of information layer or permission validation.
articles.exception: A signed installer may create or update a desktop shortcut only as a locator to MAIN_SYSTEM_DESKTOP_EXE; registered test/maintenance profiles remain non-production and isolated.

articles.subject: learning-sub-sovereign-transfer-to-xingcheng
articles.rule: TRANSFER:learning-evidence-sync-sub-sovereign is removed from automation-sovereign and becomes the learning-sub-sovereign managed exclusively by 星澄; IDENTITY:canonical active identity remains learning-evidence-sync-sub-sovereign to preserve references and lineage,display name is learning-sub-sovereign; PARENT:星澄; RELATION:privileged-institution-managed-sub-sovereign; DUTY:manage learning-evidence modules,assign bounded learning work,coordinate evidence normalization/evaluation/retention and collect outcome proof; DECISION:星澄 within its independent privileged institution and user/Codex authorization; EXECUTION:registered module executors only; BOUNDARY:the learning-sub-sovereign has no decision or execution power and cannot independently alter models,code,Codex,permissions,routing or active behavior; INFORMATION:all 星澄-to-learning-sub-sovereign instructions,events,evidence and results use the information layer,including the 星澄 auxiliary private channel where its confidentiality scope applies; SYNCHRONIZATION:automation-sovereign retains channel continuity and synchronization duties only and has no learning-sub-sovereign management authority; PRECEDENCE:this provision specifically supersedes the learning-child assignments in A188+A246+A310+A315+A322+A325+A384 while leaving their unrelated duties effective.
articles.prohibition: FORBID:automation-sovereign managing learning-sub-sovereign+dual parent+learning-sub-sovereign decision or execution+direct private call outside information layer+learning evidence used to mutate active behavior without authorization and verification.
articles.exception: Synchronization modules may transport opaque learning events under channel law but acquire no learning ownership,content authority or management power.

articles.subject: automation-sovereign-canonical-rename
articles.rule: RENAME:synchronization-sovereign is canonically renamed automation-sovereign; DISPLAY:自動主宰; IDENTITY:automation-sovereign is the sole active identity and inherits without expansion every former synchronization-sovereign duty,power,restriction,child relationship,module decision assignment,contract,receipt and lineage; RETIREMENT:the former name is a historical deprecated alias only and cannot authenticate,decide,receive assignment or coexist as an active sovereign; SCOPE:automation-sovereign decides automation synchronization,resource convergence,channel continuity,state convergence,release/update transactions,repair/backup,cleanup/retention,automatic logging and dependency coordination through its assigned sub-sovereigns,excluding learning-sub-sovereign transferred to 星澄 by A485; EXECUTION:its exceptional certified update execution remains limited exactly by A330 and all other execution stays with registered module executors; MIGRATION:all current registries,contracts,metadata,rosters,module assignments,permission viewers and machine references resolve to automation-sovereign; compatibility input using the old alias must resolve one-way to automation-sovereign during a registered bounded migration and output only the canonical identity.
articles.prohibition: FORBID:active synchronization-sovereign identity+dual old/new sovereigns+old alias authentication or authority+rename used to expand power+learning-sub-sovereign returned to automation-sovereign+unregistered string substitution at runtime.

articles.subject: timestamp-version-model-exclusive-successor
articles.rule: SUCCESSOR:A487 completely supersedes A48+E34+E69+E86+P43+P51+P59+A285+A286 for current version issuance and amendment operation. CURRENT-VERSION-LAW:A411+A412 only.
