articles.rule: Information Layer owns transport semantics; PostgreSQL owns canonical persistence of declared transport state; declared-domain sovereign owns business decisions; permission governance owns authorization; registered transport executor performs delivery. A database row never alone constitutes a valid message. Valid submission requires authenticated source, contract, permission, destination, envelope and budget validation before persistence, delivery and receipt. Accepted envelopes are immutable and delivery changes are appended separately. Ordering is declared per contract and scope. Delivery retry preserves message identity, payload hash and scoped idempotency key. Transport and audit remain distinct and link only through message and correlation identities. AUDIT_EVENT_V1 is the sole logical audit event contract; persistence is append-only within declared chains and checkpoint manifests aggregate chain roots. Runtime roles cannot update, delete, truncate, bypass policy or own audit tables. Audit reads are scoped and store references only, never reusable secrets. Transport health is distinct from database readiness and consumer lag is bounded without silent dropping. INFORMATION_SQL_CLOSURE can be evaluated only after SQL_GOVERNANCE_CLOSURE PASS and requires all thirteen information SQL gates PASS.
articles.prohibition: FORBID:SQL row as channel authorization+route invention+destination rewrite+message reinterpretation+business execution by persistence layer+accepted envelope mutation+retry identity replacement+unscoped idempotency+transport table as audit ledger+audit UPDATE,DELETE or TRUNCATE+secret persistence+database ping treated as transport health+silent oldest-message drop+contract breaking change through table mutation.
articles.exception: No missing evidence may PASS. Missing evidence is INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE; confirmed boundary, integrity, privilege or chain violation is FAIL.

articles.subject: sql-transaction-concurrency-pool-migration-execution-and-outbox-inbox-closure
articles.rule: Each governed operation has one declared transaction boundary and commits all required effects or rolls back all. Allowed policies are ATOMIC_SINGLE_DATABASE, ATOMIC_WITH_OUTBOX, READ_ONLY_SNAPSHOT and BEST_EFFORT_NONAUTHORITATIVE; best effort is forbidden for canonical official data, security projection and central audit authority. Every data class declares minimum isolation, concurrency, locking and conflict policies. Retryable writes require operation identity, scoped idempotency and existing receipt return on duplicates. Canonical mutable records require expected revision comparison and revision increment; LAST_WRITE_WINS is forbidden by default. Connection pools reuse resources only and deterministically reset transaction, role, search path, session settings and requester context. Database login role, application principal and requester identity are distinct; session context is never authority and must match current authorization projection and generation. SQL_MIGRATION_EXECUTOR is the sole migration executor, uses one global lock, executes registered SQL only and emits SQL_MIGRATION_RECEIPT_V1. Production runtime inspects and fails closed on version mismatch and cannot automatically migrate. Canonical write plus outbox is atomic; inbox dedup provides exactly-once effect over at-least-once delivery. Serialization, deadlock and lock failures follow declared retry classes and stale decisions are reevaluated. SQL governance closure is the aggregate of authority, schema-migration, information SQL and transaction-concurrency domains, all of which must PASS.
articles.prohibition: FORBID:partial authoritative success+undeclared concurrency policy+canonical best effort+default last-write-wins+blind stale retry+pool authorization carryover+session variable as authority+runtime schema auto-modification+parallel migration+unregistered migration SQL+commit-before-event without atomic outbox+duplicate consumer effect+database delivery called exactly-once network delivery.
articles.exception: Explicit low-value owner-private noncanonical state may use declared last-write-wins or best effort. No canonical, permission, audit or transport authority receives that exception.

articles.subject: complete-sql-governance-successor-and-five-domain-release-closure
articles.rule: This article is the complete successor consolidation for SQL governance. PostgreSQL is canonical persistence for declared central structured data, shared transport persistence, central audit persistence and security projection; SQLite is noncanonical owner-private operational technology with bounded degradation only. Migration chain is the sole schema evolution authority; complete object inventory, canonical DDL normalization, replay and live introspection must agree. Permission sovereign owns permission decisions; Information Layer owns channel and transport semantics; domain sovereigns own domain decisions; data governance owns declared data semantics and integrity; registered executors perform SQL work; databases create no sovereign, permission or business authority; Codex performs no SQL execution. SQL_GOVERNANCE_CLOSURE PASS requires SQL_AUTHORITY_CLOSURE, SQL_SCHEMA_MIGRATION_CLOSURE, INFORMATION_SQL_CLOSURE, SQL_TRANSACTION_CONCURRENCY_CLOSURE and SQL_RECOVERY_CLOSURE all PASS with current-version evidence, deterministic suite PASS and formal evaluator parity PASS.
articles.prohibition: FORBID:in-place mutation of prior sealed law identity+partial SQL closure PASS+prior-version evidence reuse+database authority promotion+live drift legalization+unregistered object or migration+unsafe privilege+unbounded SQLite degradation+uncovered retryable canonical write+implicit canonical last-write-wins+pool session leakage+parallel migration+transport or audit bypass+unaccepted restore authority+status-only PASS.
articles.exception: A release with no executable or database-affecting artifact requires explicit unaffected-scope proof; it does not convert any incomplete SQL domain to PASS.

articles.subject: 全專案架構圖
articles.rule: 法典、主權、資訊層、主系統、資料權威與七個獨立工具依 Architecture Registry 建立唯一現行拓撲。
articles.prohibition: 禁止由圖形自行創設權限或身分。
articles.exception: 無。

articles.subject: Git 架構圖
articles.rule: 單一 Git repository 透過已登錄 worktree、同步協調器、治理稽核及唯一推送者完成整合。
articles.prohibition: 禁止 worker 直接推送、改寫歷史或自動解決衝突。
articles.exception: 無。

articles.subject: SQL 架構圖
articles.rule: SQL 權威、schema migration、information SQL、transaction concurrency 與 recovery 五個閉合域共同控制 SQL 治理。
articles.prohibition: 禁止部分通過或 SQLite 權威升格。
articles.exception: 無。

articles.subject: RAG 架構圖
articles.rule: 受治理來源經權限驗證、切塊、PostgreSQL 正式中繼資料、Qdrant 語意候選、融合、重排及證據上下文形成結果。
articles.prohibition: 禁止無來源、跨範圍或候選資料升格。
articles.exception: 無。

articles.subject: 程式語言架構圖
articles.rule: Python、TypeScript／TSX、JavaScript、C++、C、C# 只可透過已版本化 IPC、ABI 與平台契約互通。
articles.prohibition: 禁止未登錄跨語言呼叫或語言 runtime 取得治理權威。
articles.exception: 無。

articles.subject: 七個獨立工具架構圖
articles.rule: 現行獨立工具只有 AI_ASSISTANT、AI_COLLABORATION、FILE_SORTER、INVESTMENT_MOBILE、LOCAL_MODEL、VAULTLY、MODEL_DIALOGUE。
articles.prohibition: 禁止增加第八個工具、把星澄或 System Rescue 列為工具、恢復 Global Cleaner。
articles.exception: 無。

articles.subject: 中文法典五分卷鏡像法
articles.rule: 中文鏡像由五個同版本、有序、雜湊鏈結且可重建組合根的唯讀分卷構成。
articles.prohibition: 禁止缺卷、重號、斷鏈或三分卷 current。
articles.exception: 無。

articles.subject: 架構圖與法典同步法
articles.rule: 五個共通架構圖與七個工具架構圖必須綁定現行法典版本、來源條文、內容雜湊與唯讀狀態。
articles.prohibition: 禁止 stale、missing、hash mismatch 或未登錄架構圖。
articles.exception: 無。

articles.subject: 歷史工具拓撲更正
articles.rule: 本條已由 A532 與本次 successor 取代，只保留歷史 lineage。
articles.exception: 無。

articles.subject: 歷史星澄工具分類更正
articles.rule: 本條已由後續 successor 取代；星澄不是獨立工具。
articles.exception: 無。

articles.subject: 七工具名冊法
articles.rule: 七工具 exact set 為 AI_ASSISTANT、AI_COLLABORATION、FILE_SORTER、INVESTMENT_MOBILE、LOCAL_MODEL、VAULTLY、MODEL_DIALOGUE。
articles.prohibition: 禁止 subset、superset 或別名增生。
articles.exception: 無。

articles.subject: 現行拓撲衝突閉合法
articles.rule: A66、E46、A280、A529、A530 的舊 current 拓撲已退出 effective set；七工具、System Rescue、Global Cleaner 與星澄依最新分類治理。
articles.prohibition: 禁止舊名冊重新成為 current authority。
articles.exception: 無。

articles.subject: 七工具與機構拓撲完整整改 successor
articles.rule: SUCCESSOR:A533 完整取代 A66 的 module-execution-layer 名冊語義，並控制現行工具拓撲。MODULE-EXECUTION-LAYER=MAIN_SYSTEM internal execution services plus exact seven independent tools. INDEPENDENT-TOOLS=AI_ASSISTANT|AI_COLLABORATION|FILE_SORTER|INVESTMENT_MOBILE|LOCAL_MODEL|VAULTLY|MODEL_DIALOGUE. SYSTEM_RESCUE=MAIN_SYSTEM internal service only. GLOBAL_CLEANER=retired+non-executable. 星澄=independent-privileged-institution，排除於 system module layer、independent-tool set、LOCAL_MODEL child、MODEL_DIALOGUE child 與 MAIN_SYSTEM internal service。STAR_DIRECTORY parent=XINGCHENG_INSTITUTION_ROOT。
articles.prohibition: 禁止：module self-governance、cross-owner execution、retired tool execution、System Rescue 工具化、星澄工具化、工具數量不等於七、物理路徑推導治理 parent。
articles.exception: Global Cleaner 歷史 identity、lineage 與 audit 可保留，但不得啟動、路由、核發新權限或恢復 current 身分。

articles.subject: 七工具與機構拓撲完整 successor
articles.rule: SUCCESSOR:A534 完整取代 A66 與 A533 的現行拓撲效力。MODULE-EXECUTION-TOPOLOGY=MAIN_SYSTEM-internal-services+EXACT-SEVEN-INDEPENDENT-TOOLS。INDEPENDENT-TOOLS=AI_ASSISTANT|AI_COLLABORATION|FILE_SORTER|INVESTMENT_MOBILE|LOCAL_MODEL|VAULTLY|MODEL_DIALOGUE。SYSTEM_RESCUE=MAIN_SYSTEM-internal-service-only。GLOBAL_CLEANER=retired+non-executable。XINGCHENG=independent-privileged-institution+not-tool+not-system-module+outside-independent-tool-set。STAR_DIRECTORY parent=XINGCHENG_INSTITUTION_ROOT。
articles.exception: 歷史 identity、lineage、audit、past test/fault/path evidence 保留，但不得恢復現行效力。

articles.subject: 身分與會話驗證基線
articles.rule: 全系統身分、session、permission 與 governed request 僅依 registered identity、process attestation、nonce、時間界線、single-use session、token/signature verification、identity/authorization/revocation generation、audience、scope、purpose、confirmation reference、correlation/operation identity 與 audit evidence。驗證順序須 fail-closed 並與 TOKEN_V1 對齊。
articles.prohibition: 禁止由未註冊的人體特徵來源產生身分、權限、提升權限、啟動工具、接受 session、存取 Codex 或核准 release；禁止保存秘密 token、私鑰或可重播 credential。
articles.exception: 歷史 sealed 內容只保留歷史效力；任何缺少實作或測試證據的 current closure 必須為 INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE。

articles.subject: 隱私與個資最小化 successor
articles.rule: SUCCESSOR:A536 取代 A248 的現行效力。SCOPE=personal+sensitive+private+financial+behavioral data。RULE=purpose limitation+data minimization+classification+lawful basis+field-level access+retention+erasure+non-inference。已撤銷的身分因子不得被收集、保存、索引、快取、傳送、備份、同步、寫入 audit payload 或用於任何授權決策。
articles.exception: 密碼學完整性、內容定址、簽章驗證與竄改偵測機制不受影響。

articles.subject: 退役清理、架構同步與執行時限條例
articles.rule: A537 補充 A528 與 A534。退役模組必須標示為 trash，由星澄助理執行獨立稽查與分類，再交由自動清理排程處理；清理前必須驗證 retired、non-authoritative、retention-expired、zero-current-dependency 與 audit-ready。正式法典、五份中文法典鏡像、machine architecture registry 與全部架構圖必須在同一 successor generation 同步。STARTUP_DEADLINE_SECONDS=10；MANDATORY_TEST_SUITE_DEADLINE_SECONDS=20；INDEPENDENT_AUDIT_FLOW_DEADLINE_SECONDS=30。啟動時限自使用者啟動至主畫面 READY；測試時限涵蓋每一強制測試套件至最終結果；審計時限涵蓋每一獨立審計流程至簽發結果。
articles.exception: 僅保留依法封存的歷史 identity、lineage 與 audit evidence；任何逾時一律 fail-closed。

articles.subject: 自動法典更新強制同步條例
articles.rule: A538 補充 A382、A488、A528 與 A537。任何自動法典更新必須以單一受治理 successor transaction 同時產生並驗證：正式法典、五份有序中文法典鏡像、machine architecture registry、五個共通架構圖與七個獨立工具架構圖。提交前必須完成版本一致性、內容一致性、五分卷鏈結、架構來源條文、登錄資料與治理稽核檢查。全部目標成功後才能原子發布；任何一項缺失、失敗、過期或版本不同，必須回復整批候選並拒絕發布。
articles.exception: 人工或緊急流程亦不得豁免同步；只能停止候選，不得發布部分結果。

articles.subject: 法典文字完整性與轉碼防護條例
articles.rule: A539 補充 A382、A488、A527、A528 與 A538。正式法典、五份中文法典與全部架構圖必須使用 UTF-8，並在候選發布前拒絕替代字元、連續問號占位、錯誤轉碼片段、非預期控制字元及不可還原文字。既有受損顯示文字得以不改變規範語義的精確修復交易更正，並必須重建搜尋文件、中文鏡像、修訂鏈與 seal roots。
articles.exception: 合法問句中的單一問號不受禁止；歷史語義不得藉文字修復而改寫。

articles.subject: 獨立工具五秒生命週期與本地模型選擇啟動條例
articles.rule: A540 補充 A526、A534、A537 與 A538。七個獨立工具的每次啟動及每次關閉各自必須在 5 秒內完成，並回報可驗證的最終狀態；逾時必須終止當次操作、標示失敗並 fail-closed，不得將仍在啟動、仍在關閉或未知狀態宣告為成功。LOCAL_MODEL 預設不得啟動，也不得加入系統預設啟動、預熱、自動復原啟動或背景自動重啟。主畫面必須提供 LOCAL_MODEL 專用啟動與關閉開關；只有使用者明確操作或綁定該次操作的有效單項許可才可啟動。關閉後必須維持停止，直至下一次明確許可。
articles.exception: 系統啟動的 10 秒總時限不放寬任何工具的 5 秒個別時限；已在執行的受治理任務仍須依關閉契約安全終止。

articles.subject: 模型對話星澄優先自動路由條例
articles.rule: A541 補充 A534、A537、A538 與 A540。模型對話執行自動路由時，預設第一候選固定為星澄。只有星澄未啟動、不可用、能力不符合請求或治理邊界拒絕時，才可依已登錄且可審計的備援順序轉用其他模型。星澄優先是路由順位，不構成啟動授權；不得藉此繞過 LOCAL_MODEL 預設關閉、使用者啟動開關、權限、資源與網路邊界。每次改走備援必須記錄原因、候選狀態、選定模型與 correlation identity。
articles.exception: 使用者明確指定其他已登錄模型時可覆寫單次路由順位，但不得改變系統預設值或擴張權限。

articles.subject: 外部協作雙欄使用者介面條例
articles.rule: A542 補充 A526、A528 與 A538。外部協作主工作區固定採雙欄配置：左側占可用工作區三分之一，承載協作輸入窗口、提示操作與內建 AI 清單；右側占三分之二，專供受治理內建瀏覽器網頁畫面。瀏覽器邊界必須隨視窗尺寸同步，且不得覆蓋左側控制區。窄螢幕得改為單欄，但桌面尺寸不得改變一比二的主要比例。
articles.exception: 診斷、狀態與導覽控制得置於工作區上方，但不得改變左右欄的權責與比例。

articles.subject: 外部協作介面收斂條例
articles.rule: SUCCESSOR:A543 取代 A542 的現行介面效力。外部協作最上方主卡片必須採緊湊高度，並承載完整內建 AI 名單、選取、狀態、開啟、登入與 URL 設定；禁止另設 AI 名單卡片。主工作區左側四分之一承載協作輸入與結果，右側四分之三專供受治理內建瀏覽器網頁畫面。整體狀態、選取 AI、回覆狀態、內建瀏覽器四張診斷卡及登入或人機驗證狀態卡不得顯示。
articles.exception: 窄螢幕得切換單欄；操作錯誤仍可在相關控制元件就地呈現，但不得恢復已刪除的狀態卡。

articles.subject: 外部協作整合控制與自動記錄條例
articles.rule: SUCCESSOR:A544 取代 A543 的現行介面效力。外部協作最上方必須只有一張緊湊整合主卡片，統一承載網址工具列、內建 AI 名單、AI 選取、狀態、開啟、登入、URL 設定及協作需求輸入。AI 名單的開啟、登入與開啟選取操作必須直接控制同一視窗右側的受治理內建瀏覽器。左側四分之一只承載協作結果，右側四分之三承載內建瀏覽器網頁。獨立 AI 名單卡、需求卡、共享記憶卡、四張診斷卡與登入提示狀態卡不得顯示。每次協作完成後，系統必須自動記錄需求與回覆摘要，不提供手動共享記憶卡。
articles.exception: 窄螢幕得切換單欄；錯誤得在相關控制元件就地呈現，但不得恢復已刪除卡片。

articles.subject: 外部協作需求卡片退役條例
articles.rule: SUCCESSOR:A545 取代 A544 的需求呈現條款。外部協作介面不得建立或顯示任何需求卡片；最上方整合區只保留非卡片式協作輸入，左側結果區只顯示各 AI 回覆。協作內容仍須由系統自動記錄，不得以歷史需求卡片作為記錄介面。
articles.exception: 錯誤得在輸入控制元件旁就地顯示，但不得形成需求卡片。

articles.subject: 星澄內部自我升級條例
articles.rule: 星澄的自動升級與自我更新由星澄在自身擁有域內自行產生、分析、測試、驗證、發布及回復。該生命週期不經星澄助理、系統自動更新開關、獨立工具或外部執行者；星澄助理的系統自動更新控制只適用於主系統更新。星澄自我升級不設使用者開關，但仍須保留候選隔離、相容性驗證、回歸測試、可回復發布與完整稽核。
articles.exception: 星澄得透過受治理網路通道取得研究資料，但資料只能形成未驗證候選，不得直接替換現行版本。

articles.subject: 故障手冊移交星澄學習模組條例
articles.rule: 故障手冊目錄、手冊學習攝取、使用回饋與手冊更新建議移交 learning-evidence-sync-sub-sovereign 管理，並由星澄指揮。fault-code-directory、故障身分、故障分類及其正式權威仍由 permission-sovereign 持有。學習模組只得唯讀攝取正式手冊並產生可追溯學習證據，不因管理手冊而取得故障身分修改權、修復決策權或修復執行權。
articles.exception: 手冊正式內容的法典修訂仍須走受治理修訂及驗證流程。

articles.subject: 星澄內部故障告知與自主維修條例
articles.rule: 故障訊息必須經資訊層內部通道直接告知星澄，由星澄自主發起受治理維修，並完成可修復性判定、權限檢核、稽核登錄、執行、獨立驗證及學習回饋。星澄助理必須保留故障與維修結果的訊息通知，但該通知僅為狀態投影，不構成許可、決策或執行入口，亦不得阻擋或延遲星澄自主維修。
articles.exception: 不可確定安全修復時必須停止修改、保留現況並以狀態通知呈現，不得直接覆蓋或重置。

articles.subject: 全專案 DAG／CAG／RAG 混合架構條例
articles.rule: 全專案的查詢、索引、修復及知識處理必須採用 DAG、CAG、RAG 混合架構。DAG 是 Directed Acyclic Graph 編排面，負責工作流規劃、依賴、併發、重試、超時、取消、補償與證據彙整，不得取代 Application Service；唯一契約名稱為 RagDagPlanner、RagDagExecutor、RagDagNode、RagDagEdge、RagDagExecutionContext、RagDagExecutionResult。CAG 是 Cache-Augmented Generation 加速與上下文重用面，所有快取必須具有版本、租戶、模組、身分、權限範圍、資料分類、查詢正規化、模型及策略版本、來源 revision、建立與到期時間、失效原因和權威標記；快取命中仍須通過 CAG Gate 的 scope、permission、revision、expiry 與 authority 驗證，且不得取代 RAG。RAG 是 canonical knowledge retrieval 面，保留 Hybrid、Code、Memory、Agentic 四子架構。正式路徑固定為 Caller→Information Channel→Permission／Scope→RagApplicationService→DAG Planner／Executor→CAG Gate→RAG Retrieval→Evidence Fusion→Reranker→Context Builder→Local LLM→Citation Validation→Result。DAG 節點必須採註冊型別與宣告式欄位，至少涵蓋 retrieval、cache-lookup、cache-validate、fusion、rerank、context-build、model-inference、citation-validation、index、repair、verification 與 publish-barrier；狀態限定 pending、ready、running、succeeded、failed、skipped、cancelled、requires-reconcile、quarantined，任何循環、未註冊節點、越權依賴或不完整證據均 fail-closed。查詢、multi-RAG、索引、重建與修復必須分別建立有界 DAG；Agentic 擴展受步數、時間、成本、權限及資料範圍限制。CAG 初期至少實作 L1 至 L3，L4 必須另經明文核准；所有快取只屬 derived 或 cache，不得成為官方事實來源。Qdrant 維持語義候選索引，PostgreSQL 維持中央正式結構化資料、共享傳輸與中央稽核權威；SQLite 只准模組私有、有界、可觀測、須調和的 degraded fallback。所有結果必須保留來源標記、引用驗證、權限決策、執行圖、節點結果、延遲、失敗原因與關聯身分。本條所列執行元件、machine contract、測試、安全門與效能基準目前均為 mandated-pending-implementation；只有法典、中文鏡像與法典架構圖同步完成，不得據此宣稱 runtime 已實作或驗證通過。
articles.exception: 僅允許依正式 capability degradation matrix 使用已驗證且有明確期限、容量、來源與調和目標的降級資料；不得改變權威邊界。

articles.subject: 星澄模組行數豁免條例
articles.rule: 星澄及其身分、人格、自我學習、自動編程、自動修復、自我升級與其他明確登錄為星澄所有的內部模組，不適用 E160、A426 至 A430 所定的一般模組有效行數上限；不得僅因該等模組超過模組行數門檻而判定違規、阻擋合併、要求拆分或建立模組分解工作。來源行數量測仍可作為非阻擋式維護資訊，但結果必須標記 XINGCHENG_MODULE_LINE_LIMIT_EXEMPT，且不得轉換為發布拒絕或修正義務。本豁免只涵蓋模組層級行數限制，不解除函式、方法、類別、公開入口、可呼叫項目、依賴邊界、權限、安全、測試、審計、效能、證據及可維護性要求。
articles.exception: 星澄明確移交給其他所有者的模組，自移交生效版本起不再適用本豁免；共同擁有或所有權不明時不得適用。

articles.subject: language-positioning-and-responsibility
articles.rule:
Python 開發與訓練（PyTorch / Autograd / Pretraining / SFT / MoE 訓練 / 權重匯出）；C++ 正式推論（Transformer 推論 / 模型載入 / KV Cache / Sampling / 資源管理）；C 核心引擎（Tensor 基礎運算 / SIMD / 記憶體管理 / CPU Kernel / 穩定 C ABI）；C# 業務編排（模型選擇 / 任務調度 / 生命週期 / 資源預算 / 狀態管理）。
C ABI is the only stable C/C++ interface; C++ must not enter the C core layer; cross-language access only through registered versioned contracts; language boundaries never change data, permission or decision ownership.

articles.subject: gpu-acceleration-separate-track
articles.rule:
CUDA / Triton / Gluon are a separate GPU acceleration technology track. They are not forced into the pure-C engine and are not required to be rewritten in C. The C core keeps CPU kernels and the stable C ABI only.
The GPU track bridges to the C core and PyTorch only through equivalence thresholds (logits <= 1e-3) and fail-closed fallback; the C core must not carry GPU kernels or C++.

articles.subject: xingcheng-model-architecture-moe
articles.rule:
Xingcheng's model architecture direction is MoE (sparse experts): token-choice top-k routing, SwiGLU experts, auxiliary load-balance and z-loss, router health metrics (expert load / entropy / utilization / collapse detection).
Routing health (balanced load, no collapse) is part of the model acceptance criteria; dense checkpoints remain valid for compatibility and rollback.
Sparse inference execution, grouped GEMM in the C core and expert weight management are implementation work (blueprint P3d/P3f, R5), not part of this provision.

articles.subject: xingcheng-autonomous-training-and-upgrade
articles.rule:
Xingcheng may autonomously train and upgrade itself; no user switch exists for self-learning or self-upgrade.
verified examples (quality-gated) -> star-transformer-sft/v1 snapshot -> governed SFT/DPO job (MoE-capable) -> evaluation suites -> lifecycle register/stage/activate (auto_activate only when every gate passes) -> retention policy.
Autonomous-upgrade evidence counts toward maturity level L7 (controlled evolution).

articles.subject: git-sql-rag-cag-dag-integration-division
articles.rule:
Five-plane integration and automated division of labor: Git is the source and history authority (never a data authority); PostgreSQL is canonical; RAG is the canonical retrieval plane; CAG is a safe, versioned, scoped, non-authoritative cache; DAG is the bounded acyclic orchestration plane (query / multi-RAG / index / rebuild / repair) and never replaces the Application Service.
Sovereigns decide and divide work only; registered module executors perform it; workers and the self-commit service never push; conflicts stop the cycle for human resolution; timeouts fail closed; a CAG hit is never authority; a DAG must not be cyclic or unbounded; every automatic action is auditable.

articles.subject: xingcheng-unified-model-maturity
articles.rule:
Unified model maturity standard (star-model-maturity/v1), LEVEL 0-7: L0 structure_init (模型結構可初始化); L1 forward_backward (Forward/Backward 正常); L2 overfit_small (小資料集成功過擬合); L3 effective_pretrain (完成有效語料預訓練); L4 generation (具備獨立語言生成能力); L5 dialogue_instruction (多輪對話與指令遵循); L6 reasoning_tools (可驗證推理與工具使用); L7 controlled_evolution (受控持續學習與版本演進).
Maturity must be decided only by actual executed tests; levels must pass consecutively and the first fail/skipped level caps the certification; parameter count (and other scale metrics such as data volume or training steps) is recorded as evidence only and must never automatically raise maturity.
Implementation exists (xingcheng/infrastructure/native_transformer/maturity.py); current certified level L4 (checkpoint chat-foundation-v1/final.pt, report maturity-20260920-132413.json).

articles.subject: xingcheng-model-training-tiers
articles.rule:
Model training maturity tiers keyed to configuration: T1 light (Dense small ~5M / medium ~27M; MoE small_moe ~20M total / ~7M activated) target L0-L3; T2 basic (Dense base ~100M; MoE base_moe ~497M total / ~157M activated) target L3-L4; T3 main (Dense xlarge ~500M; MoE xlarge_moe ~2.9B total / ~842M activated) target L4-L5; T4 flagship (Dense large ~1.2B; MoE large_moe ~6.9B total / ~2.0B activated) target L5-L6.
Tiers define training goals, resource budgets and additional acceptance only; they never constitute maturity. Certification remains by executed L0-L7 tests (FR-MODEL-MATURITY) and configuration size must not skip or auto-raise any level. Every MoE tier carries the routing-health gate (entropy / balanced load / no collapse); tier progression is T1 to T4 in order unless the governor rules otherwise.
Online weights are an 81.8M dense checkpoint (L4 certified); medium_moe (~146M total / ~44M activated) was attempted but did not converge; all other tiers are untrained.

articles.subject: xingcheng-pretraining-data-pipeline
articles.rule:
Complete pretraining data pipeline with eleven mandatory elements: Corpus Registry, Dataset Version, Language Classification, Source Tracking, License Validation, Unicode Normalization (with original-to-normalized mapping), Document Deduplication, Sequence Packing, Training/Validation Split, Token Count, Dataset Integrity. Language direction: Traditional Chinese primary, then English, programming languages, mathematics, science, general knowledge and reading comprehension.
Training data must be traceable, verifiable and reproducible. Confidential codex content (including the five zh-TW mirror parts and the codex database), permission data, Xingcheng private auxiliary channels, runtime state / audit journals and unauthorized data must never be added to a training set automatically (fail-closed); license validation precedes ingestion. Normalization must preserve the original-to-normalized mapping and must not damage code, paths, proper nouns or semantics.
training/corpus.py implements source scan, minimal normalization, exact-hash deduplication, deterministic split and file hashes; it lacks a corpus registry, dataset_version field, per-document language classification, license validation, NFC plus mapping, near-duplicate detection and a dataset-level integrity check. Its default sources include governance_rule/codex and the .txt suffix admits the confidential zh-TW mirror parts, so the exclusion fix is urgent.

articles.subject: single-shared-blueprint
articles.rule:
All workers share exactly one planning document: Standalone tools/local-model/星澄模型四層建置藍圖.md. No other blueprint, roadmap or phased-plan document may be created in any directory, worktree or tool folder; all planning output (phases, acceptance, gaps, dependency orders) goes into that single file.
Domain authority and evidence documents (codex mirrors, contracts, rules documents, READMEs) remain in their own locations but must not grow into parallel blueprints. shared-layer/SQL_LAYER_GOVERNANCE_BLUEPRINT.md was deleted on 2026-09-20 and its planning content is consolidated into the shared blueprint (chapter 6); the deleted content remains in Git history.
Consolidated and enforced in AGENTS.md (Single Shared Blueprint section) and in blueprint invariant 17.

articles.subject: xingcheng-ntp-correctness-tests
articles.rule:
Next Token Prediction correctness standard: the autoregressive relation (Input A B C D -> Target B C D EOS) is verified by an independent test matrix NT-1-NT-12: Sequence Shift, Input/Target IDs, Attention Mask, Causal Mask, EOS Handling, Vocabulary Range, Ignore Index, Label Mask, Cross Entropy, Loss Reduction, target-leak defense, and training/inference tokenizer consistency.
The model must never obtain information from positions greater than t during prediction; training loss must exclude padding and masked positions (ignore_index = pad_id); training and inference tokenizers must be the same artifact (hash-identical). Negative tests are mandatory: injected padding must not change the loss, out-of-vocabulary ids must fail, and mutating targets must not change same-position logits.
modules/model.py implements the standard shift-by-one with ignore_index=pad_id; existing tests cover causality (with/without mask) and KV causal consistency, but there is no dedicated NTP matrix (gap G35, Phase 2T).

articles.subject: xingcheng-small-model-training-baseline
articles.rule:
Small Model training baseline on the existing small 5M dense configuration: twelve checks (scratch init, data intake, backward, optimizer weight updates, loss decrease, checkpoint save, checkpoint restore, independent token generation, overfit test first, formal training, complete metrics, anti-memorization) and seven mandatory metrics (Training Loss, Validation Loss, Perplexity, Tokens Per Second, GPU Memory peak, Training Time, Gradient Norm pre-clip) recorded in a reproducible star-native-baseline/v1 report.
The overfit test on a fixed small dataset must pass before formal training (loss <= 0.5 or <= 20% of initial value; weights restored afterwards). Training quality must not be judged by training loss alone: validation loss and unseen-prompt generation probes are mandatory, and a divergent validation curve must be reported as overfit rather than a passing baseline.
pretrain.py records loss/validation/perplexity/tokens-per-second/elapsed but not GPU memory or gradient norm; checkpoint resume exists; an overfit smoke precedent exists from Phase 0 (gap G37, Phase 2B).

articles.subject: xingcheng-primary-goal-command-and-chat
articles.rule:
Xingcheng's primary goal is to understand commands (Traditional Chinese first; preserve the original sentence; extract intent/action/object/parameters/constraints aligned with star-semantic-plan/v1) and to chat with users (multi-turn dialogue, instruction following, reasonable answers rather than training-data recitation). Native inference serves dialogue and command understanding; Ollama remains teacher/expert only and never replaces the neural core.
The current capability threshold is maturity L5 (multi-turn dialogue and instruction following) with command-understanding probes alongside dialogue probes; L6 reasoning/tools and L7 controlled evolution are extensions. Destructive operations keep the safety gate (ambiguity yields SAFE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED and no execution). Dialogue auto-routing keeps Xingcheng as the first candidate (A541) and the local model stays off by default (A540) behind the user switch.
Command understanding is specified in the Traditional Chinese command flow document and star-semantic-plan/v1; that path currently runs on the routed model stack, not yet on Xingcheng's native weights; the L5 gate exists in maturity.py.

articles.subject: xingcheng-medium-base-scaling-strategy
articles.rule:
Scaling strategy: after the Small baseline passes acceptance, validate scaling with medium 27M and then base 100M. Every model keeps the same data version, the same evaluation data, a compatible tokenizer, and independent weights, checkpoints and training records. Comparison matrix: parameter count, training tokens, validation loss, perplexity, generation quality, training throughput, inference throughput, VRAM usage.
Parameter count must never be used as capability evidence by itself; scaling claims require measurable improvement on the shared evaluation set together with the cost columns (throughput, VRAM), and a model that fails the threshold must not be declared a successful scale-up.
Small 5M baseline smoke executed on CPU (overfit PASS, val ppl 2988.7 -> 2656.6 after resume); medium/base runs and comparison matrix do not exist yet (gap G38, Phase 9A).

articles.subject: xingcheng-moe-training-quality-control
articles.rule:
MoE training quality control for the existing Top-2 router with 4/8 experts, Router FP32 and FMA: eight training checks (Router Logits, Router Probability, Expert Selection, Expert Dispatch, Expert Output, Expert Combine, Router Gradient, Expert Gradient), five health metrics (Expert Utilization, Expert Token Distribution, Router Entropy, Load Balance Loss, Expert Collapse Detection), gradient reachability for every trainable expert, and a Dense/MoE comparison (total parameters, active parameters, measured FLOPs, training speed, inference speed, model quality).
Tokens must not concentrate on a few experts; every expected trainable expert must receive gradients under the appropriate test conditions; real MoE execution cost must be measured (FLOPs, throughput) and never inferred from active parameters alone; MoE validation must not block already-usable Dense models.
XingChengMoE implements Top-2 routing, per-expert SwiGLU, load-balance plus z-loss and health metrics; there is no dedicated MoE test, the Router FP32 claim is not verified in code, and inference remains a per-expert Python loop (gap G39, Phase 9B).

articles.subject: xingcheng-native-dialogue-training
articles.rule:
Native dialogue training after base pretraining: System/User/Assistant/Tool roles (text-level markers, star-chat-format/v1); the model must understand the user question, conversation history, current task, answer format, tool results and end conditions; nine Traditional Chinese dialogue data categories (daily conversation, multi-turn follow-up, semantic ellipsis, typo understanding, mixed Chinese/English, code, math, reading, tool use).
A reply such as 'continue' must extend the unfinished task according to the current dialogue state and must not execute a fixed answer from the bare word; training and evaluation must handle conversation roles, assistant spans and the loss mask correctly (assistant content only; system/user/tool and padding excluded).
star-chat-format/v1 and prompt-masked SFT exist; the nine-category Traditional Chinese dialogue set, continuation counter-examples and the role/mask acceptance matrix do not (gap G40, Phase 5D).

articles.subject: xingcheng-python-cpp-inference-consistency
articles.rule:
Python/C++ inference consistency on shared weights: Python runs the PyTorch transformer, C++ runs the native core with AVX2 and FMA, and both use the same tokenizer, config, weight, input ids and position ids. Layer-wise comparison covers Embedding, RMSNorm, RoPE, Attention, MLP, MoE, hidden states, logits and generation.
Per-layer error tolerances must be reasonable and verifiable; bit-exact equality must not be demanded across different CPU/GPU floating-point orderings; the quantized path (INT8/INT4) is tested separately with its own thresholds; any difference must not cause unacceptable inference-quality degradation (logit deltas, top-1 agreement, greedy token equality, perplexity delta).
Dispatch parity is measured at 6.6e-7 for matmul/softmax/attention; a full layer-wise harness and tolerance table do not exist (gap G41, Phase 5E).

articles.subject: xingcheng-kv-cache-correctness-and-performance
articles.rule:
KV cache correctness and performance tests: FP16/BF16 and INT8 caches; six checks (cache position, cache length, cache update, GQA KV head mapping, RoPE position, context overflow); Full Forward versus Prefill+Decode stepwise logits comparison; INT8 quantization error measured separately; contexts short/medium/long/maximum; recorded VRAM, RAM, prefill latency, decode latency and tokens per second.
Performance gains must never be exchanged for unevaluated severe quality loss.
The six checks are test-locked (test_phase7_kv_cache.py) and the INT8 384-token delta is +0.025%; the four-context five-metric performance matrix and the separate INT8 threshold are not established (gap G42, Phase 5F).

articles.subject: xingcheng-native-capability-evaluation
articles.rule:
Independent native capability evaluation suite with nine categories (Traditional Chinese, English, mathematics, code, reading comprehension, multi-turn dialogue, context tracking, instruction following, tool-call format). Every native model test disables third-party answering; each run records Model ID, Model Version, Tokenizer Version, Dataset Version, Inference Backend, Quantization and Evaluation Result; the same reserved tests run before and after each model update; test data must not overlap training data; a capability regression must not auto-publish a new model.
The ten-item native capability proof matrix (own tokenizer for Traditional Chinese, own transformer inference, own-weight generation, real pretraining, multi-turn dialogue training, same model in Python/C++, Dense/MoE training and inference, KV-cache accelerated generation, save/restore/evaluate/release, generation with Ollama disabled) is verified evidence and not a claim.
native_eval_suite (star-native-eval-suite/v1) exists with seven metrics; the nine-category suite, metadata fields, train/test non-overlap check and regression gate are not implemented (gap G43, Phase 5G).

articles.subject: xingcheng-weight-evolution
articles.rule:
Model weight evolution without direct overwrite of the active weights: stage objects Candidate Model, Training Checkpoint, Evaluation Result, Verified Model, Active Model; flow: current model -> create candidate -> train -> save candidate weights -> integrity verification -> capability evaluation -> inference consistency check -> release gate -> active model.
Release follows the existing GPTBridge certification, release and activation rules (lifecycle and adapter registry; automatic_weight_replacement stays 0). A training failure keeps the current official model; rolling back to uncertified old weights is forbidden.
lifecycle (11 states, weights never overwritten) and the adapter registry exist; the five stage objects and the end-to-end eight-step evolution drill are not formalized (gap G44, Phase 7B).

articles.subject: gptbridge-system-convergence
articles.rule:
Full-system convergence without new sovereigns or a new supreme control center: close the loops (decision/execution/observation/verification/record/repair/re-verify; code-change/test/release/verify/blue-green swap/observe/next-update) across ten areas: blue-green backend update with active-generation fencing, unified runtime state (run states plus capability states with existing fail-closed integrity checks preserved), preventive maintenance inside the existing five maintenance sub-modules with bounded retries, SQL interactive/background/migration workload classes, RAG incremental indexing with RECONCILE_REQUIRED and periodic reconciliation, model resource scheduling by role, Git worktree integration pipeline with cross-module contract tests, unified contract compatibility with separated version axes, a process registry that only terminates owned and authorized processes, and a project performance baseline measured before optimizing; plus the 24-hour end-to-end acceptance scenario.
No parallel supreme control center and no new sovereigns; single-instance work is fenced by the active generation; UI layers (renderer/preload/main) are validated separately from backend releases; data-integrity checks keep the existing fail-closed codex rules.
Blueprint chapter 10 records the plan; the P0-1 inventory and the P0-2..P0-6 implementations do not exist yet (gaps G46-G51).

articles.subject: gptbridge-connection-recovery-and-event-sequence
articles.rule:
Frontend-backend connection resilience beyond a single WebSocket reconnect: backend update (new requests to the new release, old requests finish), backend crash (gateway reconnects, UI keeps state), Electron main crash (launcher/watchdog restores it); three recovery levels: transport, backend release restart/rollback, application launcher/watchdog. LLM streaming continuity keeps received tokens, reconnects, queries generation state by request id, continues the draining backend's stream when possible and otherwise shows an honest interrupted state with a regenerate action. A unified event-sequence envelope (request_id, backend_generation, sequence, event, data) lets the gateway detect duplicate, lost and out-of-order events for model streaming, maintenance state and Git results.
An interrupted generation must never be presented as still generating; the transport layer alone is insufficient for backend or application recovery.
Blueprint section 10.14 records the design; three-level recovery, streaming continuity and the event-sequence envelope are not implemented (gap G52).

articles.subject: gptbridge-maintenance-update-integration
articles.rule:
Maintenance and update systems integrated through the existing five maintenance sub-sovereigns (no new sovereign): updater creates the release candidate, backer takes the necessary backup, health monitor confirms the current version is healthy, updater starts the new version, health monitor checks it, updater performs the cutover, health monitor observes continuously; on failure the maintenance sovereign dispatches the repairer to restore a compatible previous version, and the cleaner only removes staging after the observation window. Release retention tiers: ACTIVE (serving), PREVIOUS (last good, kept after a successful update), ROLLBACK (version-pinned compatible fallback), ARCHIVE (older, compressed/offline).
The cleaner must never delete the previous version immediately after a successful update (a new version may fail ten minutes later); a tier may only be demoted after the new version is stable across the observation window, the backup is verified and the rollback path is confirmed; every cleanup is audited and rollback only targets certified compatible versions.
Blueprint section 10.15 records the flow and tiers; the integration and retention tiers are not implemented (gap G53).

articles.subject: gptbridge-unified-task-lifecycle
articles.rule:
One task lifecycle for every work-producing feature (Chat, Coding, RAG, Git, File Sorter, AI Collaboration, Maintenance, Updater): CREATED, VALIDATED, AUTHORIZED, QUEUED, RUNNING, COMPLETED with error branches FAILED, CANCELLED, TIMED_OUT, RECOVERING and the added state INTERRUPTED (the task itself did not necessarily fail; the executing backend was interrupted or replaced). Identifiers: Task ID, Request ID, Operation ID, Execution Receipt, Idempotency Key, with the Operation ID surviving backend updates.
Interrupted tasks are verified by maintenance (files and Git state) before any recovery, and RUNNING tasks must not simply be re-executed because side effects may already have completed (for example a successful Git commit); exactly-once external side effects are never promised - the implementable target is persistent tasks, idempotent operations and verify-then-recover; the design integrates the existing codex receipt/obligations architecture and must not create a second audit system.
Blueprint section 10.16 records the lifecycle; the unified state machine and identifiers are not implemented (gap G54).

articles.subject: gptbridge-runtime-execution-lease
articles.rule:
Runtime execution lease inside the existing runtime/maintenance framework (no new sovereign) so that blue-green backends cannot duplicate singleton work: only the backend holding a valid lease (backend_generation, lease_type, holder, expires_at, fencing_token) may execute scheduled maintenance, cleanup, backup or migration; handover is new-version health pass -> stop new tasks to A -> revoke A eligibility -> grant B -> gateway cutover.
The lease needs a single authoritative source and atomic handover (two processes writing active=True in their own memory is forbidden); execution endpoints (database writes, scheduling, backup) must verify the fencing token so a recovered old process cannot run expired work; this must be implemented before the blue-green update goes live.
Blueprint section 10.17 records the lease design; no lease table, authority or fencing verification exists (gap G55).

articles.subject: gptbridge-release-manifest
articles.rule:
Project-wide release manifest (release_id, git_commit, backend_version, frontend_version, ipc_contract_version, database_schema_version, codex_schema, codex_version, build_hash, status) instead of relying on Git commits alone; before any cutover the manifest must validate codex compatibility, permission-definition compatibility, IPC compatibility, SQL schema compatibility and frontend compatibility.
The manifest may only reference the codex verified version and seal digest; the codex must never be treated as a hot-updatable configuration file that a release overwrites.
Blueprint section 10.18 records the manifest schema and the compatibility gate; neither exists in the repository (gap G56).

articles.subject: gptbridge-dev-runtime-separation
articles.rule:
Development source and production runtime are separated: coding agents edit the working tree while the production system executes from runtime/releases/release-A or release-B. A release must contain backend code, shared runtime dependencies, required contracts, the dependency lock and build metadata - otherwise a development shared-layer can still be imported even when main-system is pinned.
PostgreSQL data, Qdrant indexes, model weights and user data must not be copied per release.
Blueprint section 10.19 records the layout and contents; runtime/releases and the release packaging do not exist (gap G57).

articles.subject: gptbridge-backend-lifecycle-contract
articles.rule:
Unified backend lifecycle contract with ten states (STARTING, READY, DEGRADED, STANDBY, ACTIVE, DRAINING, RECOVERING, FAILED, STOPPING, STOPPED) and a strict separation between lifecycle role (STANDBY/ACTIVE/DRAINING, transitions STARTING/STOPPING/STOPPED) and health state (READY/DEGRADED/RECOVERING/FAILED) - READY and ACTIVE are not mutually exclusive same-class states (ACTIVE+READY and STANDBY+READY are both valid). Status fields: backend_id, release_id, generation, lifecycle_state, health_state, started_at, last_heartbeat, active_requests, accepting_new_requests, last_error.
Existing equivalent fields must be reused; a second parallel status system must not be created.
Only fragments exist (hot_reload_watcher active_generation_hint, preflight standby-generation handover, connection_watchdog watchdog generation, python-backend duplicate-backend guard); no unified contract (gap G58, section 10.21).

articles.subject: gptbridge-integration-sequence
articles.rule:
Convergence engineering proceeds one capability, one workspace and one acceptance group at a time: first the existing-capability inventory (INTEGRATION-01), then unified backend lifecycle contract (02), gateway and request registry (03), release manifest (04), standby backend (05), execution lease (06), atomic handover (07), rollback/recovery (08), SQL/RAG compatibility verification (09) and the persistent-operation acceptance (10).
The first engineering step is the inventory, not blue-green implementation, so that a duplicate gateway, updater, runtime registry or process manager is never built; each stage completes and records its gaps in the shared blueprint before the next begins.
Blueprint section 10.20 records the sequence; no stage has started (gap G59).

articles.subject: gptbridge-request-registry
articles.rule:
Extend the existing request tracking on the Electron Main <-> Python Backend connection instead of creating a second registry. Every request can carry request_id, session_id, task_id, backend_id, backend_generation, release_id, method, created_at, started_at, completed_at, status, timeout, cancellation_state and error_code; fields that do not apply may be null. Existing structures are extended directly: TaskRecord (command/stage/phase/percent/status/created_at), the IPC request_id/cancelled handling and the UI backend_generation outbox.
Backward compatibility is mandatory: new fields are optional and additive, legacy commands without a request_id receive an auto-assigned id through an adapter, the IPC command format version does not change, and rollout goes observable first, cancelable second, handover-capable last. The registry is the authority view that survives backend updates (Electron Main/IPC layer) with backend events carrying the event sequence.
Fragments exist (TaskRecord, IPC request_id/cancelled, UI backend_generation); the fourteen-field registry and the legacy adapter do not (gap G61, section 10.22).

articles.subject: gptbridge-request-lifecycle-and-streaming-attribution
articles.rule:
Request lifecycle for the extended registry: CREATED/QUEUED/RUNNING/COMPLETED/FAILED/CANCELLED/TIMED_OUT/INTERRUPTED with defined legal transitions (CREATED->QUEUED; QUEUED->RUNNING/CANCELLED/TIMED_OUT; RUNNING->COMPLETED/FAILED/CANCELLED/TIMED_OUT/INTERRUPTED; INTERRUPTED->RUNNING/FAILED/CANCELLED after verification). Requests record their backend generation at creation and are never reassigned mid-execution; this phase only tracks, it does not implement backend switching. Streaming token events must map to request_id/backend_generation/sequence by reusing existing fields (state_event already carries sequence and backend_generation with dedup and gap detection) and must never create a second streaming protocol; mixed tokens across requests, cancelled requests updating the UI, duplicate completion events and wrong attribution after a backend switch are forbidden. Cross-backend streaming resume is out of scope. The registry only records and tracks; it never decides execution, file modification, database operations or version updates and never bypasses the existing IPC security flow.
Terminal states must not complete twice; repeated cancellation must be idempotent; when completion and cancellation race, exactly one final result is locked by the single authority and the other event is recorded as a late event. Acceptance covers ten cases in an isolated test environment: normal completion, concurrent requests, cancellation, timeout, repeated cancellation, completion/cancellation race, backend disconnection marking, streaming attribution, legacy IPC compatibility and non-bypass of permission/audit - the running production backend must not be stopped or modified.
Blueprint sections 10.23-10.25 record the lifecycle, streaming attribution and acceptance; none is implemented (gap G62).

articles.subject: gptbridge-connection-state-reconnect-backpressure
articles.rule:
Connection layer hardening on the existing React -> Electron Main -> Backend Gateway -> Request Registry -> Python Backend path: connection states CONNECTING/CONNECTED/RECONNECTING/DISCONNECTED/CLOSED where DISCONNECTED is temporary and CLOSED forbids further auto-reconnects, with connection state kept separate from backend lifecycle state (ACTIVE plus RECONNECTING may hold simultaneously); bounded exponential backoff with jitter, maximum interval, connect timeout, single WebSocket and single reconnect loop, no reconnect after formal shutdown, authentication and handshake re-verified on every reconnect, and no automatic re-execution of unconfirmed non-idempotent operations; on disconnect the request registry is never cleared and each request is judged by state (COMPLETED/CANCELLED never re-run, RUNNING checks the original backend, QUEUED follows persistence and execution eligibility) with no cross-backend migration in this phase.
Streaming keeps per-request sequences (request_id/backend_generation/sequence/event_type reused with backward-compatible extension), recognises duplicate/expired/out-of-order/gap events, never re-applies applied events and never duplicates tokens after reconnect; buffers are bounded with congestion detection, never silently drop completion events, never merge different requests and safely terminate or mark the stream when the bound is insufficient; the existing heartbeat is reused and distinguishes transport-liveness, backend-process-liveness, backend READY and backend DEGRADED (a connected WebSocket does not mean the system is healthy and a degraded Qdrant does not force a disconnect); the UI is not redesigned and no second global UI state store is created; the gateway transports connections and events only and never authorises execution, reconnect never bypasses authentication and codex checks, and tokens/passwords/credentials never appear in debug logs; this phase may only modify the existing gateway, WebSocket client, request registry, the necessary event and connection-state contracts and their tests. Acceptance requires seventeen cases in an isolated test backend (normal connect; reconnect when the backend is not started; temporary disconnect after connect; recovery; repeated disconnects; shutdown during reconnect; concurrent requests; streaming interruption; duplicate, expired and out-of-order streaming events; cancellation racing reconnect; backend exited but gateway unaware; authentication re-run on reconnect; legacy IPC compatibility; buffer at capacity; backend completed but the response was lost without blindly redoing non-idempotent work); the running production backend must never be interrupted or modified.
Blueprint section 10.26 records the specification; none of the connection-state, reconnect, backpressure or heartbeat distinctions are implemented (gap G63).

articles.subject: gptbridge-integrated-objectives
articles.rule:
Integrated blueprint objectives: seven operational goals (high speed, high performance, low load, automated operation, high stability, autonomous learning and upgrade); Xingcheng can chat with the user and complete tasks through governed permission and safety gates; no huge dataset is required; the model is quantifiable, distillable, accelerable, reason-capable and web-searchable. Each objective maps to an existing blueprint mechanism (acceleration chapter, resource governance, automation division, convergence chapter, self-learning, L5/L6, T1-T4 tiers, maturity ladder, teacher-distillation pipeline, C core / C++ layer / caches / quantization, governed web channel).
The objectives must be pursued through the existing sovereign structure and mechanisms; no new sovereign or parallel control system is introduced.
Blueprint integrated-objectives block records the mapping; the objectives themselves are program goals, not new components.

articles.subject: gptbridge-implementation-precedence
articles.rule:
Blueprint-implementation integration policy: when the implementation already provides a better solution (including one backed by passing tests), keep the implementation and write it back into the blueprint; never roll back a superior implementation merely to match the blueprint; write-backs carry evidence (commit/tests) and update the priority queue and gap status in the same pass.
Mandatory (blueprint invariant 18): the blueprint is the single planning document, but it follows verified implementation advantages rather than overriding them; a superior, tested implementation is never rolled back to match the blueprint; every write-back records the commit hash or test evidence and the affected blueprint section, and updates the priority queue and gap status in the same pass.
Policy recorded in the blueprint integration-principles block with the first write-back table (GQA without KV expansion, SQL pool ceiling, Git watcher I/O, Router FP32 plus MoE QC 8/8, prefix cache, corpus protected-source exclusion, lazy RAG/CAG handover, staged-index safeguard).

articles.subject: xingcheng-multi-configuration-gpt
articles.rule:
Xingcheng is a multi-configuration GPT-family model: one decoder-only autoregressive architecture family with Dense (small/medium/base/xlarge/large) and MoE (small/base/xlarge/large) configurations; tokenizer, evaluation and lifecycle are shared while weights, checkpoints and training records are independent per configuration and the configuration is recorded in the release manifest; inference configurations additionally cover precision (FP32/BF16/INT8/INT4), KV quantisation, CPU/GPU and the Python/C++ paths.
Configuration identity must be explicit in the release manifest and evaluation metadata; changing a configuration is a model change and must pass the same maturity and evaluation gates.
Presets exist in XingChengConfig; the multi-configuration identity and its manifest field are not yet recorded.

articles.subject: xingcheng-tool-calling-competence
articles.rule:
Xingcheng does not need to own many tool capabilities - tools are provided by governed tools and executors - but it must know how to call tools: emit valid star-tool-call/v1 calls with correct parameters, interpret tool results and handle errors and denials; every call routes through the information channel and permission checks, and tool results remain unverified inputs until validated.
Xingcheng never authorises or executes tools itself; tool-calling competence is part of maturity L6 and the Phase 6 acceptance.
tool_call_format.py (star-tool-call/v1) exists; the L6 acceptance matrix and governed tool routing are still pending (Phase 6 / G3).

articles.subject: ollama-on-demand-activation
articles.rule:
Ollama is not resident; it starts on demand (teacher distillation, expert consultation, embeddings/reranker, routing to Ollama models) through the governed lazy-activation pattern already used by ModelServiceActivationBroker, and is unloaded when idle via keep_alive/resource management. Fail-closed: a failed start reports degraded and never silently switches to an unauthorised path. After shutdown it is never pre-warmed or silently restarted; only a new explicit demand or a single-item permission may start it again.
Start/stop is audited and registered in the Process Registry; only an Ollama process started by GPTBridge may be stopped by it - a user-started service can only be requested/prompted, never force-killed. Cold-start latency and first-token latency enter the performance baseline.
Ollama is registered as a resident external service and probed at startup; routing, distillation and embeddings depend on it. The on-demand policy is not yet implemented.

articles.subject: main-system-on-demand-modules
articles.rule:
The main system keeps only a minimal resident core (IPC/command routing, governance and permission gates, launcher and runtime state, backend gateway and request registry, bounded maintenance health monitoring); every other module and service starts on demand: the full RAG/CAG/DAG pipeline, the local model and Ollama, independent tools, embeddings/reranker, teacher distillation, indexing and offline maintenance. Activation is governed lazy activation with a readiness wait and idle unload; failures are fail-closed and reported as degraded; there is no pre-warm, no silent restart and no silent fallback to an unauthorised path. Capability state stays separate from run state so the UI shows not-started rather than failed; activation counts, cold-start latency, readiness waits and unload counts enter the performance baseline.
Existing lazy implementations (lazy RAG/CAG construction, on-demand independent tools, the model activation broker and on-demand Ollama) are the foundation; no new sovereign or parallel lifecycle is created. The goal is lower idle power and local load: modules activate only when used and unload when idle; the idle baseline (RAM/CPU/GPU power and utilisation) is the acceptance reference and must be tracked continuously, and residency must never be traded for start-up speed.
Lazy RAG/CAG and on-demand tool/model activation already exist as implementation advantages; the explicit resident-vs-on-demand policy and its observability are not yet recorded or enforced.

articles.subject: project-single-purpose-modules
articles.rule:
Every module carries a single responsibility; new functionality extends an existing single-purpose module or adds a new single-purpose module rather than accreting unrelated features; module boundaries and ownership follow architecture_registry.json and the existing size rules (A430/E160: at most three public entrypoints, twelve authored callables and five hundred effective lines); composition/orchestration layers (facade, orchestrator, router) carry no business logic; duplicate component variants are refused (inventory first, extend second).
Mandatory blueprint invariant 19; violations are governance-audit failures.
Recorded in blueprint section 10.28 and invariant 19; enforcement relies on the existing architecture-registry and source-size audits.

articles.subject: project-blockchain-style-module-records
articles.rule:
Blockchain-style data structure only (append-only hash chain with verifiable integrity; no tokens, no consensus, no P2P): one module_id maps to one dedicated hash chain of operation receipts, state changes and version publications; entries chain prev_hash + payload_hash + actor/identity + decision/correlation id + timestamp into entry_hash, and any tampering, gap or reordering fails verification fail-closed. The design reuses the existing audit chain (git_tiers/audit_chain.py chained_audit_log, git_audit_chain/, seal_manifest and revision_history) instead of creating a second ledger. Fine-grained modules each own a registry identity and an independent chain head; integrity verification (replay plus hash comparison) is provided and integrated with governor sealing and external signatures; chains store hashes and metadata only, never secrets or credentials.
Mandatory blueprint invariant 20; a failed chain-integrity verification is fail-closed; history is never rewritten or deleted.
Recorded in blueprint section 10.29 and invariant 20; the existing audit chain provides the mechanism, per-module chain heads are not yet wired.

articles.subject: main-system-multi-core-parallelism
articles.rule:
Main-system multi-core design (src-core: IPC/command routing, task queue, startup phases, core_system modules, maintenance tasks, tool lifecycle): every worker pool is bounded by the core budget (no unbounded max_workers), the thread budget (OMP/BLAS/PyTorch threads times parallel jobs) never exceeds the budget and is managed centrally, per-module quotas cover startup, IPC handling, task queue, RAG indexing work, maintenance, Git automation and tool lifecycle without starvation, the main system is CPU-parallel while the model-side GPU track is coordinated by the GPU coordinator, background work (audit/tests/indexing) yields to interactive load via the resource governor and workload classes, and observability covers CPU utilisation, parallel speedup, context switches and the idle baseline.
Mandatory blueprint invariant 21: no unbounded thread/worker creation anywhere, no oversubscription, measurable speedup with an unchanged idle baseline; complements the on-demand module policy (fewer residents free cores for real work). The operating mode is five-core parallel multi-tasking: a fixed budget of five cores, one per core engine (decision, permission, system-runtime, synchronization, xingcheng), running parallel multi-task processing; the budget may only be lowered, never raised above five cores. The budget is an application-level concurrency limit only: the local machine configuration (CPU affinity, power plan, BIOS/system settings, registry, drivers, system services) must not be changed.
Partial: adaptive envelope bounds (pool 2-8, batch 50-500, reconcile 1-2), bounded audit workers and the on-demand policy exist; unbounded executor patterns (for example startup phases) and the thread budget remain to be fixed and measured.

articles.subject: sovereigns-become-core-engines
articles.rule:
The existing sovereign functions transform into core engines: the authorities, boundaries and fail-closed behaviour are unchanged and only the implementation form changes from governance abstraction to an engine form. Mapping is one-to-one without additions or removals: decision, permission, system-runtime, synchronization and xingcheng become five core engines whose names and duties correspond to the existing provisions. Engine-form requirements: single responsibility, on-demand activation, bounded multi-core execution, append-only module hash chain and a replaceable/verifiable versioned interface.
Transition procedure: the codex remains the sole authority; the codex amendment plus registry and permission-route synchronisation must complete first; before the amendment, no renaming, no authority change and no routing change may occur. The engines must not execute module work directly, permissions and audit stay unchanged, external responses gain no authority and automation only divides work. The engines decide and coordinate with each other through versioned contracts and the event chain only (no new central coordinator; conflicts stop and escalate); all actual work is executed by governed single-purpose modules through permission check, execution lease, task lifecycle, receipt and hash-chain record under bounded parallelism and on-demand activation, and modules never authorise themselves. The core engines are implemented in pure C (C11, no C++); the cross-language boundary is a stable C ABI with Python coordination only and C# orchestration only; migration must be functionally equivalent to the existing Python implementations (implementation-precedence rule) and requires the same codex amendment first.
Blueprint section 10.31 records the transformation and invariant 22; the codex, registry and permission routes still use the sovereign form.

articles.subject: sub-sovereign-elimination-full-modularization
articles.rule:
The sub-sovereign layer is eliminated; its functions are taken over entirely by single-purpose modules while policy and decision stay with the core engines (former sovereigns). Retirement list (the thirteen current owner_sub_sovereign values): data_governance, change_acceptance, release_update_sync, startup, policy_architecture, xingcheng-assistant-identity-group, system, channel_contract_sync, repair_backup_sync, runtime_state_sync, dependency_sync, cleanup_retention_sync and language_review. Every retired function must map to one or more single-purpose modules; module manifests, architecture_registry (owner_sub_sovereign retired) and permission routes must be synchronised. Modularisation requirements: single responsibility, on-demand activation, append-only chain, bounded parallelism, versioned contracts and pure-C core engines.
Transition is codex-first: the codex amendment and an equivalence mapping table must complete first; before the amendment no deletion, renaming or routing change is allowed; migration must be functionally equivalent to the existing implementations. Authority separation, audit and fail-closed behaviour stay unchanged and modules never authorise or execute work on their own. Engines no longer have fixed module allocations: tasks are dispatched by requirement (capability, resource, permission, deadline) matched against each module's single-responsibility declaration and versioned contracts, never by fixed relationships or hard-coded routing and never self-selected by a module; unmatched or conflicting dispatches fail closed and escalate, and every dispatch decision, reason, responsible module and receipt is written to the append-only chain. Modules are implemented in pure C (C11, no C++); object-oriented components are implemented in C++ (including the production inference layer); external coordination is C# (business orchestration); Python stays limited to model research/training and data pipelines; cross-language access is only through versioned contracts (stable C ABI) and C++ must never enter the C core or the procedural modules.
Blueprint section 10.32 records the elimination and the retirement list with invariant 23; the registry still carries owner_sub_sovereign values and the sub-sovereign code paths.

articles.subject: resource-governance-throttle-protection
articles.rule: THROTTLE-SCOPE:worker/toolbox/repo-other-planes-only; PROTECTED:governance+permission+audit+fail-closed+in-flight-work never throttled-paused-or-denied-admission; ACTION-ORDER:lower-priority>affinity-cap>working-set-trim>pause-nonessential>fail-closed-admission; RELEASE:auto-on-idle+memory-pressure+budget-compliance+job-complete; LEDGER:every-regulation-action-audited; KILL-SWITCH:disables-actions-only-observation-continues; PRIORITY:A116 ordering unchanged governance-basis>core-runtime>active-user-work>background-maintenance

articles.subject: unit-system-architecture-hierarchy
articles.rule: HIERARCHY:module>unit>block mandatory|MODULE:single-responsibility+single-function|UNIT:orchestration+deployment unit same-directory same-host same-lifecycle|BLOCK:higher orchestration+isolation domain|DIRECTORY-SYNC:folder layout must mirror block/unit/module|CROSS-UNIT:governed interface (IPC/contract) only no direct import or file traversal|MEMBERSHIP:every component belongs to exactly one unit and one block
articles.prohibition: FORBID:cross-layer mixed placement+direct cross-unit import/file access+module with multiple responsibilities+unit membership omission

articles.subject: core-deployment-topology
articles.rule: CO-LOCATION:decision+permission+runtime+automation cores same host same deployment unit in-process low-latency|SEPARATION:xingcheng-assistant on separate host|CROSS-BOUNDARY:governed IPC only|ZH-TW-CODEX:visible only to xingcheng-assistant default-denied for all other cores|MAINTENANCE:codex maintained by five cores mutually visible
articles.prohibition: FORBID:xingcheng-assistant co-resident with other cores+ungoverned cross-boundary channel+zh-TW codex read by non-assistant core

articles.subject: on-demand-isolation-authority
articles.rule: GRANULARITY:isolate one unit or one module (selectable)|PURPOSE:failure boundary failure must not propagate to other units|EXECUTION:isolation+release+freeze executed by runtime core|ADJUDICATION:decision core when needed|AUDIT:full audit trail mandatory|SCOPE:on-demand only no permanent isolation without cause
articles.prohibition: FORBID:isolation executed outside runtime core+unaudited isolation+isolation bypassing decision adjudication when contested
